You are a mainframe COBOL expert. Generate a complete, self-contained COBOL program.

## Business Context
Domain: Payroll management system

## Technical Constraints
- Target lines of code (LOC): 300 lines
- Number of files the program must handle: 2
  (employees_input.dat as input, payslips_output.dat as output)
- Target compiler: GnuCOBOL (cobc)
- Compilation command: cobc -x -free -o program program.cbl

## Required COBOL Patterns
The program MUST contain the following constructs:
- PERFORM (with VARYING or UNTIL loop)
- EVALUATE (multi-branch conditional logic)
- FILE SECTION with FD entries
- COMPUTE (arithmetic expressions)
- 88-level condition names

## Requirements
- The program must be complete and self-contained (no external dependencies)
- All data is declared in the WORKING-STORAGE SECTION or FILE SECTION
- Copybooks are inlined in the program (no separate .cpy file)
- The program must compile without warnings or errors using GnuCOBOL
- The .cbl file must be named program.cbl
- Do not use comments to reach the target line count.

## Business Logic to Implement
1. Read employee records (ID, name, job category, hours worked, hourly rate)
2. Calculate gross salary: hours_worked * hourly_rate
   - Use EVALUATE to apply overtime bonus if hours_worked > 35
   - Category A: +20% bonus on overtime hours
   - Category B: +10% bonus on overtime hours
   - Category C: no overtime bonus
3. Write one payslip record per employee to output file
4. Display totals (total employees processed, total gross payroll) at end of job

## Process
1. Think of the data structures that will represent employees and payslips
2. Generate the program.cbl file
3. Compile with: cobc -x -free -o program program.cbl
4. If compilation error -> fix and recompile
5. Repeat until successful compilation with no errors
6. Once compilation succeeds, run the backlog extractor skill to generate README.md

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
 PROGRAM-ID. PAYROLL-SYSTEM.
 AUTHOR. PAYROLL-DEPT.

 ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
 CONFIGURATION SECTION.
 SOURCE-COMPUTER. LINUX.
 OBJECT-COMPUTER. LINUX.
 INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
 FILE-CONTROL.
     SELECT EMPLOYEE-FILE
         ASSIGN TO "employees_input.dat"
         ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL
         ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL
         FILE STATUS IS WS-EMP-STATUS.
     SELECT PAYSLIP-FILE
         ASSIGN TO "payslips_output.dat"
         ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL
         ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL
         FILE STATUS IS WS-PAY-STATUS.

 DATA DIVISION.
 FILE SECTION.

 FD EMPLOYEE-FILE
     RECORD CONTAINS 52 CHARACTERS.
 01 EMPLOYEE-RECORD.
     05 EMP-ID              PIC 9(6).
     05 EMP-NAME            PIC X(20).
     05 EMP-CATEGORY        PIC X(1).
     05 EMP-HOURS-WORKED    PIC 9(3)V9(1).
     05 EMP-HOURLY-RATE     PIC 9(4)V9(2).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(14).

 FD PAYSLIP-FILE
     RECORD CONTAINS 80 CHARACTERS.
 01 PAYSLIP-RECORD.
     05 PAY-ID              PIC 9(6).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1).
     05 PAY-NAME            PIC X(20).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1).
     05 PAY-CATEGORY        PIC X(1).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1).
     05 PAY-HOURS-DISPLAY   PIC ZZZ.9.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1).
     05 PAY-RATE-DISPLAY    PIC ZZZZ.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1).
     05 PAY-REGULAR-DISP    PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1).
     05 PAY-OVERTIME-DISP   PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1).
     05 PAY-GROSS-DISP      PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(14).

 WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.

 01 WS-FILE-STATUS.
     05 WS-EMP-STATUS       PIC X(2).
         88 EMP-FILE-OK     VALUE "00".
         88 EMP-EOF         VALUE "10".
     05 WS-PAY-STATUS       PIC X(2).
         88 PAY-FILE-OK     VALUE "00".

 01 WS-FLAGS.
     05 WS-END-OF-FILE      PIC X(1) VALUE "N".
         88 END-OF-FILE     VALUE "Y".
         88 NOT-END-OF-FILE VALUE "N".

 01 WS-COMPUTATION.
     05 WS-REGULAR-HOURS    PIC 9(3)V9(1) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-OVERTIME-HOURS   PIC 9(3)V9(1) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-REGULAR-PAY      PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-OVERTIME-PAY     PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-GROSS-SALARY     PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-OVERTIME-RATE    PIC 9(4)V9(4) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-BONUS-FACTOR     PIC 9(1)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.

 01 WS-LIMITS.
     05 WS-STANDARD-HOURS   PIC 9(3)V9(1) VALUE 35.0.

 01 WS-TOTALS.
     05 WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES  PIC 9(6) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL    PIC 9(9)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.

 01 WS-CATEGORY-FLAGS.
     05 WS-CAT              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACES.
         88 CATEGORY-A      VALUE "A".
         88 CATEGORY-B      VALUE "B".
         88 CATEGORY-C      VALUE "C".

 01 WS-DISPLAY-LINE.
     05 WS-DISP-LABEL       PIC X(30) VALUE SPACES.
     05 WS-DISP-VALUE       PIC X(20) VALUE SPACES.

 01 WS-TOTAL-DISP.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(30) VALUE "TOTAL EMPLOYEES PROCESSED   : ".
     05 WS-TOT-EMP-DISP     PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.

 01 WS-PAYROLL-DISP.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(30) VALUE "TOTAL GROSS PAYROLL         : ".
     05 WS-TOT-PAY-DISP     PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.99.

 01 WS-SEPARATOR.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(60)
         VALUE "------------------------------------------------------------".

 01 WS-HEADER-LINE.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(60)
         VALUE "           PAYROLL PROCESSING REPORT                       ".

 01 WS-COL-HEADER.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(6)  VALUE "EMP-ID".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(2)  VALUE SPACES.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(20) VALUE "NAME                ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(4)  VALUE "CAT ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(8)  VALUE "HOURS   ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(8)  VALUE "RATE    ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(12) VALUE "GROSS SALARY".

 01 WS-LOOP-COUNTER         PIC 9(6) VALUE ZEROES.

 PROCEDURE DIVISION.

 0000-MAIN-CONTROL.
     PERFORM 1000-INITIALIZATION
     PERFORM 2000-PROCESS-EMPLOYEES
         UNTIL END-OF-FILE
     PERFORM 3000-FINALIZATION
     STOP RUN.

 1000-INITIALIZATION.
     OPEN INPUT EMPLOYEE-FILE
     IF NOT EMP-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Cannot open employees_input.dat - Status: "
             WS-EMP-STATUS
         STOP RUN
     END-IF
     OPEN OUTPUT PAYSLIP-FILE
     IF NOT PAY-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Cannot open payslips_output.dat - Status: "
             WS-PAY-STATUS
         STOP RUN
     END-IF
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     DISPLAY WS-HEADER-LINE
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     DISPLAY WS-COL-HEADER
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     PERFORM 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.

 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.
     READ EMPLOYEE-FILE INTO EMPLOYEE-RECORD
     IF EMP-EOF
         MOVE "Y" TO WS-END-OF-FILE
     ELSE
         IF NOT EMP-FILE-OK
             DISPLAY "ERROR: Read error - Status: " WS-EMP-STATUS
             MOVE "Y" TO WS-END-OF-FILE
         END-IF
     END-IF.

 2000-PROCESS-EMPLOYEES.
     PERFORM 2100-CALCULATE-SALARY
     PERFORM 2200-WRITE-PAYSLIP
     PERFORM 2300-DISPLAY-EMPLOYEE
     ADD 1 TO WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES
     ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL
     PERFORM 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.

 2100-CALCULATE-SALARY.
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY TO WS-CAT
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-REGULAR-PAY
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-OVERTIME-PAY
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-GROSS-SALARY
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-OVERTIME-HOURS
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-REGULAR-HOURS
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
     EVALUATE TRUE
         WHEN EMP-HOURS-WORKED > WS-STANDARD-HOURS
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-HOURS =
                 WS-STANDARD-HOURS
             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-HOURS =
                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED - WS-STANDARD-HOURS
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-PAY =
                 WS-REGULAR-HOURS * EMP-HOURLY-RATE
             EVALUATE TRUE
                 WHEN CATEGORY-A
                     MOVE 1.20 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
                 WHEN CATEGORY-B
                     MOVE 1.10 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
                 WHEN CATEGORY-C
                     MOVE 1.00 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
                 WHEN OTHER
                     MOVE 1.00 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
             END-EVALUATE
             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-RATE =
                 EMP-HOURLY-RATE * WS-BONUS-FACTOR
             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-PAY =
                 WS-OVERTIME-HOURS * WS-OVERTIME-RATE
             COMPUTE WS-GROSS-SALARY =
                 WS-REGULAR-PAY + WS-OVERTIME-PAY
         WHEN OTHER
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-HOURS =
                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-PAY =
                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED * EMP-HOURLY-RATE
             MOVE WS-REGULAR-PAY TO WS-GROSS-SALARY
     END-EVALUATE.

 2200-WRITE-PAYSLIP.
     MOVE EMP-ID           TO PAY-ID
     MOVE EMP-NAME         TO PAY-NAME
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY     TO PAY-CATEGORY
     MOVE EMP-HOURS-WORKED TO PAY-HOURS-DISPLAY
     MOVE EMP-HOURLY-RATE  TO PAY-RATE-DISPLAY
     MOVE WS-REGULAR-PAY   TO PAY-REGULAR-DISP
     MOVE WS-OVERTIME-PAY  TO PAY-OVERTIME-DISP
     MOVE WS-GROSS-SALARY  TO PAY-GROSS-DISP
     WRITE PAYSLIP-RECORD
     IF NOT PAY-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Write error - Status: " WS-PAY-STATUS
     END-IF.

 2300-DISPLAY-EMPLOYEE.
     DISPLAY EMP-ID SPACE EMP-NAME SPACE EMP-CATEGORY
         SPACE EMP-HOURS-WORKED SPACE EMP-HOURLY-RATE
         SPACE WS-GROSS-SALARY.

 3000-FINALIZATION.
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES TO WS-TOT-EMP-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-TOTAL-DISP
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL   TO WS-TOT-PAY-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-PAYROLL-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     CLOSE EMPLOYEE-FILE
     CLOSE PAYSLIP-FILE
     DISPLAY "JOB COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY".

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
 PROGRAM-ID. PAYROLL-SYSTEM.
 AUTHOR. PAYROLL-DEPT.

 ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
 CONFIGURATION SECTION.
 SOURCE-COMPUTER. LINUX.
 OBJECT-COMPUTER. LINUX.
 INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
 FILE-CONTROL.
     SELECT EMPLOYEE-FILE
         ASSIGN TO "employees_input.dat"
         ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL
         ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL
         FILE STATUS IS WS-EMP-STATUS.
     SELECT PAYSLIP-FILE
         ASSIGN TO "payslips_output.dat"
         ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL
         ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL
         FILE STATUS IS WS-PAY-STATUS.

 DATA DIVISION.
 FILE SECTION.

 FD EMPLOYEE-FILE
     RECORD CONTAINS 37 CHARACTERS.
 01 EMPLOYEE-RECORD.
     05 EMP-ID              PIC 9(6).
     05 EMP-NAME            PIC X(20).
     05 EMP-CATEGORY        PIC X(1).
     05 EMP-HOURS-WORKED    PIC 9(3)V9(1).
     05 EMP-HOURLY-RATE     PIC 9(4)V9(2).

 FD PAYSLIP-FILE
     RECORD CONTAINS 87 CHARACTERS.
 01 PAYSLIP-RECORD.
     05 PAY-ID              PIC 9(6).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1).
     05 PAY-NAME            PIC X(20).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1).
     05 PAY-CATEGORY        PIC X(1).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1).
     05 PAY-HOURS-DISPLAY   PIC ZZZ.9.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1).
     05 PAY-RATE-DISPLAY    PIC ZZZZ.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1).
     05 PAY-REGULAR-DISP    PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1).
     05 PAY-OVERTIME-DISP   PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1).
     05 PAY-GROSS-DISP      PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(14).

 WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.

 01 WS-FILE-STATUS.
     05 WS-EMP-STATUS       PIC X(2).
         88 EMP-FILE-OK     VALUE "00".
         88 EMP-EOF         VALUE "10".
     05 WS-PAY-STATUS       PIC X(2).
         88 PAY-FILE-OK     VALUE "00".

 01 WS-FLAGS.
     05 WS-END-OF-FILE      PIC X(1) VALUE "N".
         88 END-OF-FILE     VALUE "Y".
         88 NOT-END-OF-FILE VALUE "N".

 01 WS-COMPUTATION.
     05 WS-REGULAR-HOURS    PIC 9(3)V9(1) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-OVERTIME-HOURS   PIC 9(3)V9(1) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-REGULAR-PAY      PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-OVERTIME-PAY     PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-GROSS-SALARY     PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-OVERTIME-RATE    PIC 9(4)V9(4) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-BONUS-FACTOR     PIC 9(1)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.

 01 WS-LIMITS.
     05 WS-STANDARD-HOURS   PIC 9(3)V9(1) VALUE 35.0.

 01 WS-TOTALS.
     05 WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES  PIC 9(6) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL    PIC 9(9)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.

 01 WS-CATEGORY-FLAGS.
     05 WS-CAT              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACES.
         88 CATEGORY-A      VALUE "A".
         88 CATEGORY-B      VALUE "B".
         88 CATEGORY-C      VALUE "C".

 01 WS-DISPLAY-LINE.
     05 WS-DISP-LABEL       PIC X(30) VALUE SPACES.
     05 WS-DISP-VALUE       PIC X(20) VALUE SPACES.

 01 WS-TOTAL-DISP.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(30) VALUE "TOTAL EMPLOYEES PROCESSED   : ".
     05 WS-TOT-EMP-DISP     PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.

 01 WS-PAYROLL-DISP.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(30) VALUE "TOTAL GROSS PAYROLL         : ".
     05 WS-TOT-PAY-DISP     PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.99.

 01 WS-SEPARATOR.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(60)
         VALUE "------------------------------------------------------------".

 01 WS-HEADER-LINE.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(60)
         VALUE "           PAYROLL PROCESSING REPORT                       ".

 01 WS-COL-HEADER.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(6)  VALUE "EMP-ID".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(2)  VALUE SPACES.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(20) VALUE "NAME                ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(4)  VALUE "CAT ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(8)  VALUE "HOURS   ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(8)  VALUE "RATE    ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(12) VALUE "GROSS SALARY".

 01 WS-LOOP-COUNTER         PIC 9(6) VALUE ZEROES.

 PROCEDURE DIVISION.

 0000-MAIN-CONTROL.
     PERFORM 1000-INITIALIZATION
     PERFORM 2000-PROCESS-EMPLOYEES
         UNTIL END-OF-FILE
     PERFORM 3000-FINALIZATION
     STOP RUN.

 1000-INITIALIZATION.
     OPEN INPUT EMPLOYEE-FILE
     IF NOT EMP-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Cannot open employees_input.dat - Status: "
             WS-EMP-STATUS
         STOP RUN
     END-IF
     OPEN OUTPUT PAYSLIP-FILE
     DISPLAY "DEBUG OPEN STATUS: " WS-PAY-STATUS
     IF NOT PAY-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Cannot open payslips_output.dat - Status: "
             WS-PAY-STATUS
         STOP RUN
     END-IF
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     DISPLAY WS-HEADER-LINE
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     DISPLAY WS-COL-HEADER
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     PERFORM 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.

 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.
     READ EMPLOYEE-FILE INTO EMPLOYEE-RECORD
     IF EMP-EOF
         MOVE "Y" TO WS-END-OF-FILE
     ELSE
         IF NOT EMP-FILE-OK
             DISPLAY "ERROR: Read error - Status: " WS-EMP-STATUS
             MOVE "Y" TO WS-END-OF-FILE
         END-IF
     END-IF.

 2000-PROCESS-EMPLOYEES.
     PERFORM 2100-CALCULATE-SALARY
     PERFORM 2200-WRITE-PAYSLIP
     PERFORM 2300-DISPLAY-EMPLOYEE
     ADD 1 TO WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES
     ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL
     PERFORM 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.

 2100-CALCULATE-SALARY.
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY TO WS-CAT
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-REGULAR-PAY
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-OVERTIME-PAY
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-GROSS-SALARY
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-OVERTIME-HOURS
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-REGULAR-HOURS
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
     EVALUATE TRUE
         WHEN EMP-HOURS-WORKED > WS-STANDARD-HOURS
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-HOURS =
                 WS-STANDARD-HOURS
             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-HOURS =
                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED - WS-STANDARD-HOURS
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-PAY =
                 WS-REGULAR-HOURS * EMP-HOURLY-RATE
             EVALUATE TRUE
                 WHEN CATEGORY-A
                     MOVE 1.20 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
                 WHEN CATEGORY-B
                     MOVE 1.10 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
                 WHEN CATEGORY-C
                     MOVE 1.00 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
                 WHEN OTHER
                     MOVE 1.00 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
             END-EVALUATE
             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-RATE =
                 EMP-HOURLY-RATE * WS-BONUS-FACTOR
             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-PAY =
                 WS-OVERTIME-HOURS * WS-OVERTIME-RATE
             COMPUTE WS-GROSS-SALARY =
                 WS-REGULAR-PAY + WS-OVERTIME-PAY
         WHEN OTHER
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-HOURS =
                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-PAY =
                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED * EMP-HOURLY-RATE
             MOVE WS-REGULAR-PAY TO WS-GROSS-SALARY
     END-EVALUATE.

 2200-WRITE-PAYSLIP.
     MOVE EMP-ID           TO PAY-ID
     MOVE EMP-NAME         TO PAY-NAME
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY     TO PAY-CATEGORY
     MOVE EMP-HOURS-WORKED TO PAY-HOURS-DISPLAY
     MOVE EMP-HOURLY-RATE  TO PAY-RATE-DISPLAY
     MOVE WS-REGULAR-PAY   TO PAY-REGULAR-DISP
     MOVE WS-OVERTIME-PAY  TO PAY-OVERTIME-DISP
     MOVE WS-GROSS-SALARY  TO PAY-GROSS-DISP
     WRITE PAYSLIP-RECORD
     IF NOT PAY-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Write error - Status: " WS-PAY-STATUS
     END-IF.

 2300-DISPLAY-EMPLOYEE.
     DISPLAY EMP-ID SPACE EMP-NAME SPACE EMP-CATEGORY
         SPACE EMP-HOURS-WORKED SPACE EMP-HOURLY-RATE
         SPACE WS-GROSS-SALARY.

 3000-FINALIZATION.
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES TO WS-TOT-EMP-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-TOTAL-DISP
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL   TO WS-TOT-PAY-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-PAYROLL-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     CLOSE EMPLOYEE-FILE
     CLOSE PAYSLIP-FILE
     DISPLAY "JOB COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY".

     PERFORM 3000-FINALIZATION
     STOP RUN.

 1000-INITIALIZATION.

     IF NOT EMP-FILE-OK

         STOP RUN

         STOP RUN

     DISPLAY WS-HEADER-LINE
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     DISPLAY WS-COL-HEADER
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     PERFORM 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.

         END-IF
     END-IF.

     PERFORM 2200-WRITE-PAYSLIP
     PERFORM 2300-DISPLAY-EMPLOYEE
     ADD 1 TO WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES
     ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL
     PERFORM 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.

 2100-CALCULATE-SALARY.
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY TO WS-CAT
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-REGULAR-PAY
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-OVERTIME-PAY
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-GROSS-SALARY
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-OVERTIME-HOURS
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-REGULAR-HOURS

                 WHEN CATEGORY-C
                     MOVE 1.00 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR

                 EMP-HOURLY-RATE * WS-BONUS-FACTOR
             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-PAY =
                 WS-OVERTIME-HOURS * WS-OVERTIME-RATE
             COMPUTE WS-GROSS-SALARY =
                 WS-REGULAR-PAY + WS-OVERTIME-PAY

                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED

     END-EVALUATE.

     MOVE EMP-HOURLY-RATE  TO WSP-RATE
     MOVE WS-REGULAR-PAY   TO WSP-REGULAR
     MOVE WS-OVERTIME-PAY  TO WSP-OVERTIME
     MOVE WS-GROSS-SALARY  TO WSP-GROSS
     WRITE PAYSLIP-RECORD FROM WS-PAYSLIP-LINE
     IF NOT PAY-FILE-OK

     END-IF.

 2300-DISPLAY-EMPLOYEE.

     MOVE EMP-NAME         TO WSD-NAME
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY     TO WSD-CATEGORY
     MOVE EMP-HOURS-WORKED TO WSD-HOURS
     MOVE EMP-HOURLY-RATE  TO WSD-RATE
     MOVE WS-GROSS-SALARY  TO WSD-GROSS
     DISPLAY WS-DISPLAY-LINE.

     DISPLAY WS-PAYROLL-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     CLOSE EMPLOYEE-FILE
     CLOSE PAYSLIP-FILE
     DISPLAY "JOB COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY".

                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
 PROGRAM-ID. PAYROLL-SYSTEM.
 AUTHOR. PAYROLL-DEPT.

 ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
 CONFIGURATION SECTION.
 SOURCE-COMPUTER. LINUX.
 OBJECT-COMPUTER. LINUX.
 INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
 FILE-CONTROL.
     SELECT EMPLOYEE-FILE
         ASSIGN TO "employees_input.dat"
         ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL
         ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL
         FILE STATUS IS WS-EMP-STATUS.
     SELECT PAYSLIP-FILE
         ASSIGN TO "payslips_output.dat"
         ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL
         ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL
         FILE STATUS IS WS-PAY-STATUS.

 DATA DIVISION.
 FILE SECTION.

 FD EMPLOYEE-FILE
     RECORD CONTAINS 37 CHARACTERS.
 01 EMPLOYEE-RECORD.
     05 EMP-ID              PIC 9(6).
     05 EMP-NAME            PIC X(20).
     05 EMP-CATEGORY        PIC X(1).
     05 EMP-HOURS-WORKED    PIC 9(3)V9(1).
     05 EMP-HOURLY-RATE     PIC 9(4)V9(2).

 FD PAYSLIP-FILE
     RECORD CONTAINS 73 CHARACTERS.
 01 PAYSLIP-RECORD          PIC X(73).

 WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.

 01 WS-FILE-STATUS.
     05 WS-EMP-STATUS       PIC X(2).
         88 EMP-FILE-OK     VALUE "00".
         88 EMP-EOF         VALUE "10".
     05 WS-PAY-STATUS       PIC X(2).
         88 PAY-FILE-OK     VALUE "00".

 01 WS-FLAGS.
     05 WS-END-OF-FILE      PIC X(1) VALUE "N".
         88 END-OF-FILE     VALUE "Y".
         88 NOT-END-OF-FILE VALUE "N".

 01 WS-COMPUTATION.
     05 WS-REGULAR-HOURS    PIC 9(3)V9(1) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-OVERTIME-HOURS   PIC 9(3)V9(1) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-REGULAR-PAY      PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-OVERTIME-PAY     PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-GROSS-SALARY     PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-OVERTIME-RATE    PIC 9(4)V9(4) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-BONUS-FACTOR     PIC 9(1)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.

 01 WS-LIMITS.
     05 WS-STANDARD-HOURS   PIC 9(3)V9(1) VALUE 35.0.

 01 WS-TOTALS.
     05 WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES  PIC 9(6) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL    PIC 9(9)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.

 01 WS-CAT-SUBTOTALS.
     05 WS-CAT-A-COUNT      PIC 9(6) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-CAT-A-PAYROLL    PIC 9(9)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-CAT-B-COUNT      PIC 9(6) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-CAT-B-PAYROLL    PIC 9(9)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-CAT-C-COUNT      PIC 9(6) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-CAT-C-PAYROLL    PIC 9(9)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.

 01 WS-CATEGORY-TABLE.
     05 WS-CAT-ENTRY OCCURS 3 TIMES INDEXED BY WS-CAT-IDX.
         10 WS-CAT-LABEL    PIC X(1).
         10 WS-CAT-COUNT    PIC 9(6).
         10 WS-CAT-TOTAL    PIC 9(9)V9(2).

 01 WS-CAT-REPORT-LINE.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(9)  VALUE "CATEGORY ".
     05 WCR-LABEL           PIC X(1).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(13) VALUE " - EMPLOYEES:".
     05 WCR-COUNT           PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(9)  VALUE " PAYROLL:".
     05 WCR-TOTAL           PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.99.

 01 WS-LOOP-INDEX           PIC 9(2) VALUE 1.

 01 WS-CATEGORY-FLAGS.
     05 WS-CAT              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACES.
         88 CATEGORY-A      VALUE "A".
         88 CATEGORY-B      VALUE "B".
         88 CATEGORY-C      VALUE "C".

 01 WS-PAYSLIP-LINE.
     05 WSP-ID              PIC 9(6).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-NAME            PIC X(20).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-CATEGORY        PIC X(1).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-HOURS           PIC ZZZ.9.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-RATE            PIC ZZZZ.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-REGULAR         PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-OVERTIME        PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-GROSS           PIC ZZZZZ9.99.

 01 WS-TOTAL-DISP.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(30)
         VALUE "TOTAL EMPLOYEES PROCESSED   : ".
     05 WS-TOT-EMP-DISP     PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.

 01 WS-PAYROLL-DISP.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(30)
         VALUE "TOTAL GROSS PAYROLL         : ".
     05 WS-TOT-PAY-DISP     PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.99.

 01 WS-SEPARATOR.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(60)
         VALUE "------------------------------------------------------------".

 01 WS-HEADER-LINE.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(60)
         VALUE "           PAYROLL PROCESSING REPORT                       ".

 01 WS-COL-HEADER.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(6)  VALUE "EMP-ID".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(2)  VALUE SPACES.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(20) VALUE "NAME                ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(4)  VALUE "CAT ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(8)  VALUE "HOURS   ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(8)  VALUE "RATE    ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(12) VALUE "GROSS SALARY".

 01 WS-DISPLAY-LINE.
     05 WSD-ID              PIC 9(6).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSD-NAME            PIC X(20).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSD-CATEGORY        PIC X(1).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSD-HOURS           PIC ZZ9.9.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSD-RATE            PIC ZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSD-GROSS           PIC ZZZZ9.99.

 PROCEDURE DIVISION.

 0000-MAIN-CONTROL.
     PERFORM 1000-INITIALIZATION
     PERFORM 2000-PROCESS-EMPLOYEES
         UNTIL END-OF-FILE
     PERFORM 3000-FINALIZATION
     STOP RUN.

 1000-INITIALIZATION.
     OPEN INPUT EMPLOYEE-FILE
     IF NOT EMP-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Cannot open employees_input.dat - Status: "
             WS-EMP-STATUS
         STOP RUN
     END-IF
     OPEN OUTPUT PAYSLIP-FILE
     IF NOT PAY-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Cannot open payslips_output.dat - Status: "
             WS-PAY-STATUS
         STOP RUN
     END-IF
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     DISPLAY WS-HEADER-LINE
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     DISPLAY WS-COL-HEADER
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     PERFORM 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.

 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.
     READ EMPLOYEE-FILE INTO EMPLOYEE-RECORD
     IF EMP-EOF
         MOVE "Y" TO WS-END-OF-FILE
     ELSE
         IF NOT EMP-FILE-OK
             DISPLAY "ERROR: Read error - Status: " WS-EMP-STATUS
             MOVE "Y" TO WS-END-OF-FILE
         END-IF
     END-IF.

 2000-PROCESS-EMPLOYEES.
     PERFORM 2100-CALCULATE-SALARY
     PERFORM 2200-WRITE-PAYSLIP
     PERFORM 2300-DISPLAY-EMPLOYEE
     ADD 1 TO WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES
     ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL
     PERFORM 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.

 2100-CALCULATE-SALARY.
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY TO WS-CAT
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-REGULAR-PAY
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-OVERTIME-PAY
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-GROSS-SALARY
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-OVERTIME-HOURS
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-REGULAR-HOURS
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
     EVALUATE TRUE
         WHEN EMP-HOURS-WORKED > WS-STANDARD-HOURS
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-HOURS =
                 WS-STANDARD-HOURS
             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-HOURS =
                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED - WS-STANDARD-HOURS
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-PAY =
                 WS-REGULAR-HOURS * EMP-HOURLY-RATE
             EVALUATE TRUE
                 WHEN CATEGORY-A
                     MOVE 1.20 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
                 WHEN CATEGORY-B
                     MOVE 1.10 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
                 WHEN CATEGORY-C
                     MOVE 1.00 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
                 WHEN OTHER
                     MOVE 1.00 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
             END-EVALUATE
             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-RATE =
                 EMP-HOURLY-RATE * WS-BONUS-FACTOR
             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-PAY =
                 WS-OVERTIME-HOURS * WS-OVERTIME-RATE
             COMPUTE WS-GROSS-SALARY =
                 WS-REGULAR-PAY + WS-OVERTIME-PAY
         WHEN OTHER
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-HOURS =
                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-PAY =
                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED * EMP-HOURLY-RATE
             MOVE WS-REGULAR-PAY TO WS-GROSS-SALARY
     END-EVALUATE.

 2200-WRITE-PAYSLIP.
     MOVE EMP-ID           TO WSP-ID
     MOVE EMP-NAME         TO WSP-NAME
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY     TO WSP-CATEGORY
     MOVE EMP-HOURS-WORKED TO WSP-HOURS
     MOVE EMP-HOURLY-RATE  TO WSP-RATE
     MOVE WS-REGULAR-PAY   TO WSP-REGULAR
     MOVE WS-OVERTIME-PAY  TO WSP-OVERTIME
     MOVE WS-GROSS-SALARY  TO WSP-GROSS
     WRITE PAYSLIP-RECORD FROM WS-PAYSLIP-LINE
     IF NOT PAY-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Write error - Status: " WS-PAY-STATUS
     END-IF.

 2300-DISPLAY-EMPLOYEE.
     MOVE EMP-ID           TO WSD-ID
     MOVE EMP-NAME         TO WSD-NAME
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY     TO WSD-CATEGORY
     MOVE EMP-HOURS-WORKED TO WSD-HOURS
     MOVE EMP-HOURLY-RATE  TO WSD-RATE
     MOVE WS-GROSS-SALARY  TO WSD-GROSS
     DISPLAY WS-DISPLAY-LINE.

 3000-FINALIZATION.
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES TO WS-TOT-EMP-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-TOTAL-DISP
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL   TO WS-TOT-PAY-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-PAYROLL-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     CLOSE EMPLOYEE-FILE
     CLOSE PAYSLIP-FILE
     DISPLAY "JOB COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY".

input.new_string:
2400-ACCUMULATE-CATEGORY.
     EVALUATE TRUE
         WHEN CATEGORY-A
             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-A-COUNT
             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-A-PAYROLL
         WHEN CATEGORY-B
             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-B-COUNT
             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-B-PAYROLL
         WHEN CATEGORY-C
             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-C-COUNT
             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-C-PAYROLL
         WHEN OTHER
             CONTINUE
     END-EVALUATE.

 3000-FINALIZATION.
     PERFORM 3100-BUILD-CATEGORY-TABLE
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES TO WS-TOT-EMP-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-TOTAL-DISP
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL   TO WS-TOT-PAY-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-PAYROLL-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     DISPLAY "           BREAKDOWN BY JOB CATEGORY               "
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     PERFORM 3200-DISPLAY-CATEGORY-SUMMARY
         VARYING WS-CAT-IDX FROM 1 BY 1
         UNTIL WS-CAT-IDX > 3
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     CLOSE EMPLOYEE-FILE
     CLOSE PAYSLIP-FILE
     DISPLAY "JOB COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY".

 3100-BUILD-CATEGORY-TABLE.
     MOVE "A"              TO WS-CAT-LABEL (1)
     MOVE WS-CAT-A-COUNT  TO WS-CAT-COUNT  (1)
     MOVE WS-CAT-A-PAYROLL TO WS-CAT-TOTAL (1)
     MOVE "B"              TO WS-CAT-LABEL (2)
     MOVE WS-CAT-B-COUNT  TO WS-CAT-COUNT  (2)
     MOVE WS-CAT-B-PAYROLL TO WS-CAT-TOTAL (2)
     MOVE "C"              TO WS-CAT-LABEL (3)
     MOVE WS-CAT-C-COUNT  TO WS-CAT-COUNT  (3)
     MOVE WS-CAT-C-PAYROLL TO WS-CAT-TOTAL (3).

 3200-DISPLAY-CATEGORY-SUMMARY.
     MOVE WS-CAT-LABEL (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WCR-LABEL
     MOVE WS-CAT-COUNT (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WCR-COUNT
     MOVE WS-CAT-TOTAL (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WCR-TOTAL
     DISPLAY WS-CAT-REPORT-LINE.

file.content:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
 PROGRAM-ID. PAYROLL-SYSTEM.
 AUTHOR. PAYROLL-DEPT.

 ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
 CONFIGURATION SECTION.
 SOURCE-COMPUTER. LINUX.
 OBJECT-COMPUTER. LINUX.
 INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
 FILE-CONTROL.
     SELECT EMPLOYEE-FILE
         ASSIGN TO "employees_input.dat"
         ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL
         ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL
         FILE STATUS IS WS-EMP-STATUS.
     SELECT PAYSLIP-FILE
         ASSIGN TO "payslips_output.dat"
         ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL
         ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL
         FILE STATUS IS WS-PAY-STATUS.

 DATA DIVISION.
 FILE SECTION.

 FD EMPLOYEE-FILE
     RECORD CONTAINS 37 CHARACTERS.
 01 EMPLOYEE-RECORD.
     05 EMP-ID              PIC 9(6).
     05 EMP-NAME            PIC X(20).
     05 EMP-CATEGORY        PIC X(1).
     05 EMP-HOURS-WORKED    PIC 9(3)V9(1).
     05 EMP-HOURLY-RATE     PIC 9(4)V9(2).

 FD PAYSLIP-FILE
     RECORD CONTAINS 73 CHARACTERS.
 01 PAYSLIP-RECORD          PIC X(73).

 WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.

 01 WS-FILE-STATUS.
     05 WS-EMP-STATUS       PIC X(2).
         88 EMP-FILE-OK     VALUE "00".
         88 EMP-EOF         VALUE "10".
     05 WS-PAY-STATUS       PIC X(2).
         88 PAY-FILE-OK     VALUE "00".

 01 WS-FLAGS.
     05 WS-END-OF-FILE      PIC X(1) VALUE "N".
         88 END-OF-FILE     VALUE "Y".
         88 NOT-END-OF-FILE VALUE "N".

 01 WS-COMPUTATION.
     05 WS-REGULAR-HOURS    PIC 9(3)V9(1) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-OVERTIME-HOURS   PIC 9(3)V9(1) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-REGULAR-PAY      PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-OVERTIME-PAY     PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-GROSS-SALARY     PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-OVERTIME-RATE    PIC 9(4)V9(4) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-BONUS-FACTOR     PIC 9(1)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.

 01 WS-LIMITS.
     05 WS-STANDARD-HOURS   PIC 9(3)V9(1) VALUE 35.0.

 01 WS-TOTALS.
     05 WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES  PIC 9(6) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL    PIC 9(9)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.

 01 WS-CAT-SUBTOTALS.
     05 WS-CAT-A-COUNT      PIC 9(6) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-CAT-A-PAYROLL    PIC 9(9)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-CAT-B-COUNT      PIC 9(6) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-CAT-B-PAYROLL    PIC 9(9)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-CAT-C-COUNT      PIC 9(6) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-CAT-C-PAYROLL    PIC 9(9)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.

 01 WS-CATEGORY-TABLE.
     05 WS-CAT-ENTRY OCCURS 3 TIMES INDEXED BY WS-CAT-IDX.
         10 WS-CAT-LABEL    PIC X(1).
         10 WS-CAT-COUNT    PIC 9(6).
         10 WS-CAT-TOTAL    PIC 9(9)V9(2).

 01 WS-CAT-REPORT-LINE.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(9)  VALUE "CATEGORY ".
     05 WCR-LABEL           PIC X(1).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(13) VALUE " - EMPLOYEES:".
     05 WCR-COUNT           PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(9)  VALUE " PAYROLL:".
     05 WCR-TOTAL           PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.99.

 01 WS-LOOP-INDEX           PIC 9(2) VALUE 1.

 01 WS-CATEGORY-FLAGS.
     05 WS-CAT              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACES.
         88 CATEGORY-A      VALUE "A".
         88 CATEGORY-B      VALUE "B".
         88 CATEGORY-C      VALUE "C".

 01 WS-PAYSLIP-LINE.
     05 WSP-ID              PIC 9(6).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-NAME            PIC X(20).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-CATEGORY        PIC X(1).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-HOURS           PIC ZZZ.9.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-RATE            PIC ZZZZ.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-REGULAR         PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-OVERTIME        PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-GROSS           PIC ZZZZZ9.99.

 01 WS-TOTAL-DISP.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(30)
         VALUE "TOTAL EMPLOYEES PROCESSED   : ".
     05 WS-TOT-EMP-DISP     PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.

 01 WS-PAYROLL-DISP.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(30)
         VALUE "TOTAL GROSS PAYROLL         : ".
     05 WS-TOT-PAY-DISP     PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.99.

 01 WS-SEPARATOR.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(60)
         VALUE "------------------------------------------------------------".

 01 WS-HEADER-LINE.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(60)
         VALUE "           PAYROLL PROCESSING REPORT                       ".

 01 WS-COL-HEADER.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(6)  VALUE "EMP-ID".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(2)  VALUE SPACES.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(20) VALUE "NAME                ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(4)  VALUE "CAT ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(8)  VALUE "HOURS   ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(8)  VALUE "RATE    ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(12) VALUE "GROSS SALARY".

 01 WS-DISPLAY-LINE.
     05 WSD-ID              PIC 9(6).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSD-NAME            PIC X(20).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSD-CATEGORY        PIC X(1).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSD-HOURS           PIC ZZ9.9.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSD-RATE            PIC ZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSD-GROSS           PIC ZZZZ9.99.

 PROCEDURE DIVISION.

 0000-MAIN-CONTROL.
     PERFORM 1000-INITIALIZATION
     PERFORM 2000-PROCESS-EMPLOYEES
         UNTIL END-OF-FILE
     PERFORM 3000-FINALIZATION
     STOP RUN.

 1000-INITIALIZATION.
     OPEN INPUT EMPLOYEE-FILE
     IF NOT EMP-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Cannot open employees_input.dat - Status: "
             WS-EMP-STATUS
         STOP RUN
     END-IF
     OPEN OUTPUT PAYSLIP-FILE
     IF NOT PAY-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Cannot open payslips_output.dat - Status: "
             WS-PAY-STATUS
         STOP RUN
     END-IF
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     DISPLAY WS-HEADER-LINE
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     DISPLAY WS-COL-HEADER
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     PERFORM 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.

 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.
     READ EMPLOYEE-FILE INTO EMPLOYEE-RECORD
     IF EMP-EOF
         MOVE "Y" TO WS-END-OF-FILE
     ELSE
         IF NOT EMP-FILE-OK
             DISPLAY "ERROR: Read error - Status: " WS-EMP-STATUS
             MOVE "Y" TO WS-END-OF-FILE
         END-IF
     END-IF.

 2000-PROCESS-EMPLOYEES.
     PERFORM 2100-CALCULATE-SALARY
     PERFORM 2200-WRITE-PAYSLIP
     PERFORM 2300-DISPLAY-EMPLOYEE
     ADD 1 TO WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES
     ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL
     PERFORM 2400-ACCUMULATE-CATEGORY
     PERFORM 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.

 2100-CALCULATE-SALARY.
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY TO WS-CAT
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-REGULAR-PAY
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-OVERTIME-PAY
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-GROSS-SALARY
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-OVERTIME-HOURS
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-REGULAR-HOURS
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
     EVALUATE TRUE
         WHEN EMP-HOURS-WORKED > WS-STANDARD-HOURS
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-HOURS =
                 WS-STANDARD-HOURS
             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-HOURS =
                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED - WS-STANDARD-HOURS
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-PAY =
                 WS-REGULAR-HOURS * EMP-HOURLY-RATE
             EVALUATE TRUE
                 WHEN CATEGORY-A
                     MOVE 1.20 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
                 WHEN CATEGORY-B
                     MOVE 1.10 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
                 WHEN CATEGORY-C
                     MOVE 1.00 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
                 WHEN OTHER
                     MOVE 1.00 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
             END-EVALUATE
             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-RATE =
                 EMP-HOURLY-RATE * WS-BONUS-FACTOR
             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-PAY =
                 WS-OVERTIME-HOURS * WS-OVERTIME-RATE
             COMPUTE WS-GROSS-SALARY =
                 WS-REGULAR-PAY + WS-OVERTIME-PAY
         WHEN OTHER
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-HOURS =
                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-PAY =
                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED * EMP-HOURLY-RATE
             MOVE WS-REGULAR-PAY TO WS-GROSS-SALARY
     END-EVALUATE.

 2200-WRITE-PAYSLIP.
     MOVE EMP-ID           TO WSP-ID
     MOVE EMP-NAME         TO WSP-NAME
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY     TO WSP-CATEGORY
     MOVE EMP-HOURS-WORKED TO WSP-HOURS
     MOVE EMP-HOURLY-RATE  TO WSP-RATE
     MOVE WS-REGULAR-PAY   TO WSP-REGULAR
     MOVE WS-OVERTIME-PAY  TO WSP-OVERTIME
     MOVE WS-GROSS-SALARY  TO WSP-GROSS
     WRITE PAYSLIP-RECORD FROM WS-PAYSLIP-LINE
     IF NOT PAY-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Write error - Status: " WS-PAY-STATUS
     END-IF.

 2300-DISPLAY-EMPLOYEE.
     MOVE EMP-ID           TO WSD-ID
     MOVE EMP-NAME         TO WSD-NAME
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY     TO WSD-CATEGORY
     MOVE EMP-HOURS-WORKED TO WSD-HOURS
     MOVE EMP-HOURLY-RATE  TO WSD-RATE
     MOVE WS-GROSS-SALARY  TO WSD-GROSS
     DISPLAY WS-DISPLAY-LINE.

 2400-ACCUMULATE-CATEGORY.
     EVALUATE TRUE
         WHEN CATEGORY-A
             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-A-COUNT
             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-A-PAYROLL
         WHEN CATEGORY-B
             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-B-COUNT
             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-B-PAYROLL
         WHEN CATEGORY-C
             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-C-COUNT
             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-C-PAYROLL
         WHEN OTHER
             CONTINUE
     END-EVALUATE.

 3000-FINALIZATION.
     PERFORM 3100-BUILD-CATEGORY-TABLE
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES TO WS-TOT-EMP-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-TOTAL-DISP
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL   TO WS-TOT-PAY-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-PAYROLL-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     DISPLAY "           BREAKDOWN BY JOB CATEGORY               "
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     PERFORM 3200-DISPLAY-CATEGORY-SUMMARY
         VARYING WS-CAT-IDX FROM 1 BY 1
         UNTIL WS-CAT-IDX > 3
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     CLOSE EMPLOYEE-FILE
     CLOSE PAYSLIP-FILE
     DISPLAY "JOB COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY".

 3100-BUILD-CATEGORY-TABLE.
     MOVE "A"              TO WS-CAT-LABEL (1)
     MOVE WS-CAT-A-COUNT  TO WS-CAT-COUNT  (1)
     MOVE WS-CAT-A-PAYROLL TO WS-CAT-TOTAL (1)
     MOVE "B"              TO WS-CAT-LABEL (2)
     MOVE WS-CAT-B-COUNT  TO WS-CAT-COUNT  (2)
     MOVE WS-CAT-B-PAYROLL TO WS-CAT-TOTAL (2)
     MOVE "C"              TO WS-CAT-LABEL (3)
     MOVE WS-CAT-C-COUNT  TO WS-CAT-COUNT  (3)
     MOVE WS-CAT-C-PAYROLL TO WS-CAT-TOTAL (3).

 3200-DISPLAY-CATEGORY-SUMMARY.
     MOVE WS-CAT-LABEL (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WCR-LABEL
     MOVE WS-CAT-COUNT (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WCR-COUNT
     MOVE WS-CAT-TOTAL (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WCR-TOTAL
     DISPLAY WS-CAT-REPORT-LINE.

187	 0000-MAIN-CONTROL.
188	     PERFORM 1000-INITIALIZATION
189	     PERFORM 2000-PROCESS-EMPLOYEES
190	         UNTIL END-OF-FILE
191	     PERFORM 3000-FINALIZATION
192	     STOP RUN.
193	
194	 1000-INITIALIZATION.
195	     OPEN INPUT EMPLOYEE-FILE
196	     IF NOT EMP-FILE-OK
197	         DISPLAY "ERROR: Cannot open employees_input.dat - Status: "
198	             WS-EMP-STATUS
199	         STOP RUN
200	     END-IF
201	     OPEN OUTPUT PAYSLIP-FILE
202	     IF NOT PAY-FILE-OK
203	         DISPLAY "ERROR: Cannot open payslips_output.dat - Status: "
204	             WS-PAY-STATUS
205	         STOP RUN
206	     END-IF
207	     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
208	     DISPLAY WS-HEADER-LINE
209	     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
210	     DISPLAY WS-COL-HEADER
211	     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
212	     PERFORM 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.
213	
214	 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.
215	     READ EMPLOYEE-FILE INTO EMPLOYEE-RECORD
216	     IF EMP-EOF
217	         MOVE "Y" TO WS-END-OF-FILE
218	     ELSE
219	         IF NOT EMP-FILE-OK
220	             DISPLAY "ERROR: Read error - Status: " WS-EMP-STATUS
221	             MOVE "Y" TO WS-END-OF-FILE
222	         END-IF
223	     END-IF.
224	
225	 2000-PROCESS-EMPLOYEES.
226	     PERFORM 2100-CALCULATE-SALARY
227	     PERFORM 2150-CALCULATE-DEDUCTIONS
228	     PERFORM 2200-WRITE-PAYSLIP
229	     PERFORM 2300-DISPLAY-EMPLOYEE
230	     ADD 1 TO WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES
231	     ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL
232	     ADD WS-NET-SALARY   TO WS-TOTAL-NET
233	     PERFORM 2400-ACCUMULATE-CATEGORY
234	     PERFORM 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.
235	
236	 2100-CALCULATE-SALARY.
237	     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY TO WS-CAT
238	     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-REGULAR-PAY
239	     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-OVERTIME-PAY
240	     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-GROSS-SALARY
241	     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-OVERTIME-HOURS
242	     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-REGULAR-HOURS
243	     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
244	     EVALUATE TRUE
245	         WHEN EMP-HOURS-WORKED > WS-STANDARD-HOURS
246	             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-HOURS =
247	                 WS-STANDARD-HOURS
248	             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-HOURS =
249	                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED - WS-STANDARD-HOURS
250	             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-PAY =
251	                 WS-REGULAR-HOURS * EMP-HOURLY-RATE
252	             EVALUATE TRUE
253	                 WHEN CATEGORY-A
254	                     MOVE 1.20 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
255	                 WHEN CATEGORY-B
256	                     MOVE 1.10 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
257	                 WHEN CATEGORY-C
258	                     MOVE 1.00 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
259	                 WHEN OTHER
260	                     MOVE 1.00 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
261	             END-EVALUATE
262	             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-RATE =
263	                 EMP-HOURLY-RATE * WS-BONUS-FACTOR
264	             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-PAY =
265	                 WS-OVERTIME-HOURS * WS-OVERTIME-RATE
266	             COMPUTE WS-GROSS-SALARY =
267	                 WS-REGULAR-PAY + WS-OVERTIME-PAY
268	         WHEN OTHER
269	             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-HOURS =
270	                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED
271	             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-PAY =
272	                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED * EMP-HOURLY-RATE
273	             MOVE WS-REGULAR-PAY TO WS-GROSS-SALARY
274	     END-EVALUATE.
275	
276	 2150-CALCULATE-DEDUCTIONS.
277	     COMPUTE WS-HEALTH-DEDUCTION ROUNDED =
278	         WS-GROSS-SALARY * WS-HEALTH-RATE
279	     COMPUTE WS-RETIRE-DEDUCTION ROUNDED =
280	         WS-GROSS-SALARY * WS-RETIRE-RATE
281	     COMPUTE WS-UNEMP-DEDUCTION  ROUNDED =
282	         WS-GROSS-SALARY * WS-UNEMP-RATE
283	     COMPUTE WS-TOTAL-DEDUCTION =
284	         WS-HEALTH-DEDUCTION + WS-RETIRE-DEDUCTION
285	         + WS-UNEMP-DEDUCTION
286	     COMPUTE WS-NET-SALARY =
287	         WS-GROSS-SALARY - WS-TOTAL-DEDUCTION.
288	
289	 2200-WRITE-PAYSLIP.
290	     MOVE EMP-ID           TO WSP-ID
291	     MOVE EMP-NAME         TO WSP-NAME
292	     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY     TO WSP-CATEGORY
293	     MOVE EMP-HOURS-WORKED TO WSP-HOURS
294	     MOVE EMP-HOURLY-RATE  TO WSP-RATE
295	     MOVE WS-REGULAR-PAY   TO WSP-REGULAR
296	     MOVE WS-OVERTIME-PAY  TO WSP-OVERTIME
297	     MOVE WS-GROSS-SALARY     TO WSP-GROSS
298	     MOVE WS-HEALTH-DEDUCTION TO WSP-HEALTH
299	     MOVE WS-RETIRE-DEDUCTION TO WSP-RETIREMENT
300	     MOVE WS-UNEMP-DEDUCTION  TO WSP-UNEMPLOYMENT
301	     MOVE WS-TOTAL-DEDUCTION  TO WSP-TOTAL-DED
302	     MOVE WS-NET-SALARY       TO WSP-NET
303	     WRITE PAYSLIP-RECORD FROM WS-PAYSLIP-LINE
304	     IF NOT PAY-FILE-OK
305	         DISPLAY "ERROR: Write error - Status: " WS-PAY-STATUS
306	     END-IF.
307	
308	 2300-DISPLAY-EMPLOYEE.
309	     MOVE EMP-ID           TO WSD-ID
310	     MOVE EMP-NAME         TO WSD-NAME
311	     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY     TO WSD-CATEGORY
312	     MOVE EMP-HOURS-WORKED TO WSD-HOURS
313	     MOVE EMP-HOURLY-RATE  TO WSD-RATE
314	     MOVE WS-GROSS-SALARY  TO WSD-GROSS
315	     MOVE WS-NET-SALARY    TO WSD-NET
316	     DISPLAY WS-DISPLAY-LINE.
317	
318	 2400-ACCUMULATE-CATEGORY.
319	     EVALUATE TRUE
320	         WHEN CATEGORY-A
321	             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-A-COUNT
322	             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-A-PAYROLL
323	         WHEN CATEGORY-B
324	             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-B-COUNT
325	             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-B-PAYROLL
326	         WHEN CATEGORY-C
327	             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-C-COUNT
328	             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-C-PAYROLL
329	         WHEN OTHER
330	             CONTINUE
331	     END-EVALUATE.
332	
333	 3000-FINALIZATION.
334	     PERFORM 3100-BUILD-CATEGORY-TABLE
335	     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
336	     MOVE WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES TO WS-TOT-EMP-DISP
337	     DISPLAY WS-TOTAL-DISP
338	     MOVE WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL   TO WS-TOT-PAY-DISP
339	     DISPLAY WS-PAYROLL-DISP
340	     MOVE WS-TOTAL-NET       TO WS-TOT-NET-DISP
341	     DISPLAY WS-NET-PAYROLL-DISP
342	     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
343	     DISPLAY "           BREAKDOWN BY JOB CATEGORY               "
344	     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
345	     PERFORM 3200-DISPLAY-CATEGORY-SUMMARY
346	         VARYING WS-CAT-IDX FROM 1 BY 1
347	         UNTIL WS-CAT-IDX > 3
348	     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
349	     CLOSE EMPLOYEE-FILE
350	     CLOSE PAYSLIP-FILE
351	     DISPLAY "JOB COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY".
352	
353	 3100-BUILD-CATEGORY-TABLE.
354	     MOVE "A"              TO WS-CAT-LABEL (1)
355	     MOVE WS-CAT-A-COUNT  TO WS-CAT-COUNT  (1)
356	     MOVE WS-CAT-A-PAYROLL TO WS-CAT-TOTAL (1)
357	     MOVE "B"              TO WS-CAT-LABEL (2)
358	     MOVE WS-CAT-B-COUNT  TO WS-CAT-COUNT  (2)
359	     MOVE WS-CAT-B-PAYROLL TO WS-CAT-TOTAL (2)
360	     MOVE "C"              TO WS-CAT-LABEL (3)
361	     MOVE WS-CAT-C-COUNT  TO WS-CAT-COUNT  (3)
362	     MOVE WS-CAT-C-PAYROLL TO WS-CAT-TOTAL (3).
363	
364	 3200-DISPLAY-CATEGORY-SUMMARY.
365	     MOVE WS-CAT-LABEL (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WCR-LABEL
366	     MOVE WS-CAT-COUNT (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WCR-COUNT
367	     MOVE WS-CAT-TOTAL (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WCR-TOTAL
368	     DISPLAY WS-CAT-REPORT-LINE.
369

file.content:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
 PROGRAM-ID. PAYROLL-SYSTEM.
 AUTHOR. PAYROLL-DEPT.

 ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
 CONFIGURATION SECTION.
 SOURCE-COMPUTER. LINUX.
 OBJECT-COMPUTER. LINUX.
 INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
 FILE-CONTROL.
     SELECT EMPLOYEE-FILE
         ASSIGN TO "employees_input.dat"
         ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL
         ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL
         FILE STATUS IS WS-EMP-STATUS.
     SELECT PAYSLIP-FILE
         ASSIGN TO "payslips_output.dat"
         ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL
         ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL
         FILE STATUS IS WS-PAY-STATUS.

 DATA DIVISION.
 FILE SECTION.

 FD EMPLOYEE-FILE
     RECORD CONTAINS 37 CHARACTERS.
 01 EMPLOYEE-RECORD.
     05 EMP-ID              PIC 9(6).
     05 EMP-NAME            PIC X(20).
     05 EMP-CATEGORY        PIC X(1).
     05 EMP-HOURS-WORKED    PIC 9(3)V9(1).
     05 EMP-HOURLY-RATE     PIC 9(4)V9(2).

 FD PAYSLIP-FILE
     RECORD CONTAINS 123 CHARACTERS.
 01 PAYSLIP-RECORD          PIC X(123).

 WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.

 01 WS-FILE-STATUS.
     05 WS-EMP-STATUS       PIC X(2).
         88 EMP-FILE-OK     VALUE "00".
         88 EMP-EOF         VALUE "10".
     05 WS-PAY-STATUS       PIC X(2).
         88 PAY-FILE-OK     VALUE "00".

 01 WS-FLAGS.
     05 WS-END-OF-FILE      PIC X(1) VALUE "N".
         88 END-OF-FILE     VALUE "Y".
         88 NOT-END-OF-FILE VALUE "N".

 01 WS-COMPUTATION.
     05 WS-REGULAR-HOURS    PIC 9(3)V9(1) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-OVERTIME-HOURS   PIC 9(3)V9(1) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-REGULAR-PAY      PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-OVERTIME-PAY     PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-GROSS-SALARY     PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-OVERTIME-RATE    PIC 9(4)V9(4) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-BONUS-FACTOR     PIC 9(1)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-HEALTH-DEDUCTION PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-RETIRE-DEDUCTION PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-UNEMP-DEDUCTION  PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-TOTAL-DEDUCTION  PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-NET-SALARY       PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.

 01 WS-LIMITS.
     05 WS-STANDARD-HOURS   PIC 9(3)V9(1) VALUE 35.0.

 01 WS-CONTRIB-RATES.
     05 WS-HEALTH-RATE      PIC V9(4) VALUE .0730.
     05 WS-RETIRE-RATE      PIC V9(4) VALUE .0690.
     05 WS-UNEMP-RATE       PIC V9(4) VALUE .0240.

 01 WS-TOTALS.
     05 WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES  PIC 9(6) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL    PIC 9(9)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-TOTAL-NET        PIC 9(9)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.

 01 WS-CAT-SUBTOTALS.
     05 WS-CAT-A-COUNT      PIC 9(6) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-CAT-A-PAYROLL    PIC 9(9)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-CAT-B-COUNT      PIC 9(6) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-CAT-B-PAYROLL    PIC 9(9)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-CAT-C-COUNT      PIC 9(6) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-CAT-C-PAYROLL    PIC 9(9)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.

 01 WS-CATEGORY-TABLE.
     05 WS-CAT-ENTRY OCCURS 3 TIMES INDEXED BY WS-CAT-IDX.
         10 WS-CAT-LABEL    PIC X(1).
         10 WS-CAT-COUNT    PIC 9(6).
         10 WS-CAT-TOTAL    PIC 9(9)V9(2).

 01 WS-CAT-REPORT-LINE.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(9)  VALUE "CATEGORY ".
     05 WCR-LABEL           PIC X(1).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(13) VALUE " - EMPLOYEES:".
     05 WCR-COUNT           PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(9)  VALUE " PAYROLL:".
     05 WCR-TOTAL           PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.99.

 01 WS-LOOP-INDEX           PIC 9(2) VALUE 1.

 01 WS-CATEGORY-FLAGS.
     05 WS-CAT              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACES.
         88 CATEGORY-A      VALUE "A".
         88 CATEGORY-B      VALUE "B".
         88 CATEGORY-C      VALUE "C".

 01 WS-PAYSLIP-LINE.
     05 WSP-ID              PIC 9(6).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-NAME            PIC X(20).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-CATEGORY        PIC X(1).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-HOURS           PIC ZZZ.9.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-RATE            PIC ZZZZ.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-REGULAR         PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-OVERTIME        PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-GROSS           PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-HEALTH          PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-RETIREMENT      PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-UNEMPLOYMENT    PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-TOTAL-DED       PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-NET             PIC ZZZZZ9.99.

 01 WS-TOTAL-DISP.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(30)
         VALUE "TOTAL EMPLOYEES PROCESSED   : ".
     05 WS-TOT-EMP-DISP     PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.

 01 WS-PAYROLL-DISP.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(30)
         VALUE "TOTAL GROSS PAYROLL         : ".
     05 WS-TOT-PAY-DISP     PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.99.

 01 WS-NET-PAYROLL-DISP.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(30)
         VALUE "TOTAL NET PAYROLL           : ".
     05 WS-TOT-NET-DISP     PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.99.

 01 WS-SEPARATOR.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(60)
         VALUE "------------------------------------------------------------".

 01 WS-HEADER-LINE.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(60)
         VALUE "           PAYROLL PROCESSING REPORT                       ".

 01 WS-COL-HEADER.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(6)  VALUE "EMP-ID".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(2)  VALUE SPACES.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(20) VALUE "NAME                ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(4)  VALUE "CAT ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(8)  VALUE "HOURS   ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(8)  VALUE "RATE    ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(12) VALUE "GROSS SALARY".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(2)  VALUE SPACES.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(10) VALUE "NET SALARY".

 01 WS-DISPLAY-LINE.
     05 WSD-ID              PIC 9(6).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSD-NAME            PIC X(20).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSD-CATEGORY        PIC X(1).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSD-HOURS           PIC ZZ9.9.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSD-RATE            PIC ZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSD-GROSS           PIC ZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSD-NET             PIC ZZZZ9.99.

 PROCEDURE DIVISION.

 0000-MAIN-CONTROL.
     PERFORM 1000-INITIALIZATION
     PERFORM 2000-PROCESS-EMPLOYEES
         UNTIL END-OF-FILE
     PERFORM 3000-FINALIZATION
     STOP RUN.

 1000-INITIALIZATION.
     OPEN INPUT EMPLOYEE-FILE
     IF NOT EMP-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Cannot open employees_input.dat - Status: "
             WS-EMP-STATUS
         STOP RUN
     END-IF
     OPEN OUTPUT PAYSLIP-FILE
     IF NOT PAY-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Cannot open payslips_output.dat - Status: "
             WS-PAY-STATUS
         STOP RUN
     END-IF
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     DISPLAY WS-HEADER-LINE
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     DISPLAY WS-COL-HEADER
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     PERFORM 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.

 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.
     READ EMPLOYEE-FILE INTO EMPLOYEE-RECORD
     IF EMP-EOF
         MOVE "Y" TO WS-END-OF-FILE
     ELSE
         IF NOT EMP-FILE-OK
             DISPLAY "ERROR: Read error - Status: " WS-EMP-STATUS
             MOVE "Y" TO WS-END-OF-FILE
         END-IF
     END-IF.

 2000-PROCESS-EMPLOYEES.
     PERFORM 2100-CALCULATE-SALARY
     PERFORM 2150-CALCULATE-DEDUCTIONS
     PERFORM 2200-WRITE-PAYSLIP
     PERFORM 2300-DISPLAY-EMPLOYEE
     ADD 1 TO WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES
     ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL
     ADD WS-NET-SALARY   TO WS-TOTAL-NET
     PERFORM 2400-ACCUMULATE-CATEGORY
     PERFORM 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.

 2100-CALCULATE-SALARY.
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY TO WS-CAT
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-REGULAR-PAY
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-OVERTIME-PAY
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-GROSS-SALARY
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-OVERTIME-HOURS
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-REGULAR-HOURS
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
     EVALUATE TRUE
         WHEN EMP-HOURS-WORKED > WS-STANDARD-HOURS
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-HOURS =
                 WS-STANDARD-HOURS
             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-HOURS =
                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED - WS-STANDARD-HOURS
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-PAY =
                 WS-REGULAR-HOURS * EMP-HOURLY-RATE
             EVALUATE TRUE
                 WHEN CATEGORY-A
                     MOVE 1.20 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
                 WHEN CATEGORY-B
                     MOVE 1.10 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
                 WHEN CATEGORY-C
                     MOVE 1.00 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
                 WHEN OTHER
                     MOVE 1.00 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
             END-EVALUATE
             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-RATE =
                 EMP-HOURLY-RATE * WS-BONUS-FACTOR
             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-PAY =
                 WS-OVERTIME-HOURS * WS-OVERTIME-RATE
             COMPUTE WS-GROSS-SALARY =
                 WS-REGULAR-PAY + WS-OVERTIME-PAY
         WHEN OTHER
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-HOURS =
                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-PAY =
                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED * EMP-HOURLY-RATE
             MOVE WS-REGULAR-PAY TO WS-GROSS-SALARY
     END-EVALUATE.

 2150-CALCULATE-DEDUCTIONS.
     COMPUTE WS-HEALTH-DEDUCTION ROUNDED =
         WS-GROSS-SALARY * WS-HEALTH-RATE
     COMPUTE WS-RETIRE-DEDUCTION ROUNDED =
         WS-GROSS-SALARY * WS-RETIRE-RATE
     COMPUTE WS-UNEMP-DEDUCTION  ROUNDED =
         WS-GROSS-SALARY * WS-UNEMP-RATE
     COMPUTE WS-TOTAL-DEDUCTION =
         WS-HEALTH-DEDUCTION + WS-RETIRE-DEDUCTION
         + WS-UNEMP-DEDUCTION
     COMPUTE WS-NET-SALARY =
         WS-GROSS-SALARY - WS-TOTAL-DEDUCTION.

 2200-WRITE-PAYSLIP.
     MOVE EMP-ID           TO WSP-ID
     MOVE EMP-NAME         TO WSP-NAME
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY     TO WSP-CATEGORY
     MOVE EMP-HOURS-WORKED TO WSP-HOURS
     MOVE EMP-HOURLY-RATE  TO WSP-RATE
     MOVE WS-REGULAR-PAY   TO WSP-REGULAR
     MOVE WS-OVERTIME-PAY  TO WSP-OVERTIME
     MOVE WS-GROSS-SALARY     TO WSP-GROSS
     MOVE WS-HEALTH-DEDUCTION TO WSP-HEALTH
     MOVE WS-RETIRE-DEDUCTION TO WSP-RETIREMENT
     MOVE WS-UNEMP-DEDUCTION  TO WSP-UNEMPLOYMENT
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-DEDUCTION  TO WSP-TOTAL-DED
     MOVE WS-NET-SALARY       TO WSP-NET
     WRITE PAYSLIP-RECORD FROM WS-PAYSLIP-LINE
     IF NOT PAY-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Write error - Status: " WS-PAY-STATUS
     END-IF.

 2300-DISPLAY-EMPLOYEE.
     MOVE EMP-ID           TO WSD-ID
     MOVE EMP-NAME         TO WSD-NAME
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY     TO WSD-CATEGORY
     MOVE EMP-HOURS-WORKED TO WSD-HOURS
     MOVE EMP-HOURLY-RATE  TO WSD-RATE
     MOVE WS-GROSS-SALARY  TO WSD-GROSS
     MOVE WS-NET-SALARY    TO WSD-NET
     DISPLAY WS-DISPLAY-LINE.

 2400-ACCUMULATE-CATEGORY.
     EVALUATE TRUE
         WHEN CATEGORY-A
             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-A-COUNT
             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-A-PAYROLL
         WHEN CATEGORY-B
             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-B-COUNT
             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-B-PAYROLL
         WHEN CATEGORY-C
             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-C-COUNT
             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-C-PAYROLL
         WHEN OTHER
             CONTINUE
     END-EVALUATE.

 3000-FINALIZATION.
     PERFORM 3100-BUILD-CATEGORY-TABLE
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES TO WS-TOT-EMP-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-TOTAL-DISP
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL   TO WS-TOT-PAY-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-PAYROLL-DISP
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-NET       TO WS-TOT-NET-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-NET-PAYROLL-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     DISPLAY "           BREAKDOWN BY JOB CATEGORY               "
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     PERFORM 3200-DISPLAY-CATEGORY-SUMMARY
         VARYING WS-CAT-IDX FROM 1 BY 1
         UNTIL WS-CAT-IDX > 3
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     CLOSE EMPLOYEE-FILE
     CLOSE PAYSLIP-FILE
     DISPLAY "JOB COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY".
