210	     05 WSD-GROSS           PIC ZZZZ9.99.
211	     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
212	     05 WSD-NET             PIC ZZZZ9.99.
213	
214	 PROCEDURE DIVISION.
215	
216	 0000-MAIN-CONTROL.
217	     PERFORM 1000-INITIALIZATION
218	     PERFORM 2000-PROCESS-EMPLOYEES
219	         UNTIL END-OF-FILE
220	     PERFORM 3000-FINALIZATION
221	     STOP RUN.
222	
223	 1000-INITIALIZATION.
224	     OPEN INPUT EMPLOYEE-FILE
225	     IF NOT EMP-FILE-OK
226	         DISPLAY "ERROR: Cannot open employees_input.dat - Status: "
227	             WS-EMP-STATUS
228	         STOP RUN
229	     END-IF
230	     OPEN OUTPUT PAYSLIP-FILE
231	     IF NOT PAY-FILE-OK
232	         DISPLAY "ERROR: Cannot open payslips_output.dat - Status: "
233	             WS-PAY-STATUS
234	         STOP RUN
235	     END-IF
236	     OPEN OUTPUT REJECT-FILE
237	     IF NOT REJ-FILE-OK
238	         DISPLAY "ERROR: Cannot open rejects_output.dat - Status: "
239	             WS-REJ-STATUS
240	         STOP RUN
241	     END-IF
242	     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
243	     DISPLAY WS-HEADER-LINE
244	     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
245	     DISPLAY WS-COL-HEADER
246	     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
247	     PERFORM 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.
248	
249	 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.
250	     READ EMPLOYEE-FILE INTO EMPLOYEE-RECORD
251	     IF EMP-EOF
252	         MOVE "Y" TO WS-END-OF-FILE
253	     ELSE
254	         IF NOT EMP-FILE-OK
255	             DISPLAY "ERROR: Read error - Status: " WS-EMP-STATUS
256	             MOVE "Y" TO WS-END-OF-FILE
257	         END-IF
258	     END-IF.
259	
260	 2000-PROCESS-EMPLOYEES.
261	     PERFORM 1900-VALIDATE-RECORD
262	     IF RECORD-VALID
263	         PERFORM 2100-CALCULATE-SALARY
264	         PERFORM 2150-CALCULATE-DEDUCTIONS
265	         PERFORM 2200-WRITE-PAYSLIP
266	         PERFORM 2300-DISPLAY-EMPLOYEE
267	         ADD 1 TO WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES
268	         ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL
269	         ADD WS-NET-SALARY   TO WS-TOTAL-NET
270	         PERFORM 2400-ACCUMULATE-CATEGORY
271	     ELSE
272	         PERFORM 1950-WRITE-REJECT
273	     END-IF
274	     PERFORM 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.
275	
276	 1900-VALIDATE-RECORD.
277	     MOVE "Y" TO WS-RECORD-VALID
278	     MOVE SPACES TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
279	     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY TO WS-CAT
280	     EVALUATE TRUE
281	         WHEN EMP-ID-X = SPACES OR EMP-ID-X = "000000"
282	             MOVE "N"       TO WS-RECORD-VALID
283	             MOVE "ERR-001" TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
284	         WHEN EMP-HOURS-WORKED <= ZEROES
285	           OR EMP-HOURS-WORKED > 80
286	             MOVE "N"       TO WS-RECORD-VALID
287	             MOVE "ERR-002" TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
288	         WHEN EMP-HOURLY-RATE <= ZEROES
289	           OR EMP-HOURLY-RATE > 999.99
290	             MOVE "N"       TO WS-RECORD-VALID
291	             MOVE "ERR-003" TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
292	         WHEN NOT (CATEGORY-A OR CATEGORY-B OR CATEGORY-C)
293	             MOVE "N"       TO WS-RECORD-VALID
294	             MOVE "ERR-004" TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
295	     END-EVALUATE.
296	
297	 1950-WRITE-REJECT.
298	     MOVE EMPLOYEE-RECORD   TO WRJ-EMP-DATA
299	     MOVE WS-VALIDATION-CODE TO WRJ-ERROR-CODE
300	     WRITE REJECT-RECORD FROM WS-REJECT-LINE
301	     IF NOT REJ-FILE-OK
302	         DISPLAY "ERROR: Reject write error - Status: "
303	             WS-REJ-STATUS
304	     END-IF
305	     ADD 1 TO WS-TOTAL-REJECTED
306	     DISPLAY "REJECTED [" WS-VALIDATION-CODE "]: "
307	         EMP-ID SPACE EMP-NAME.
308	
309	 2100-CALCULATE-SALARY.
310	     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY TO WS-CAT
311	     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-REGULAR-PAY
312	     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-OVERTIME-PAY
313	     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-GROSS-SALARY
314	     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-OVERTIME-HOURS
315	     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-REGULAR-HOURS
316	     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
317	     EVALUATE TRUE
318	         WHEN EMP-HOURS-WORKED > WS-STANDARD-HOURS
319	             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-HOURS =
320	                 WS-STANDARD-HOURS
321	             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-HOURS =
322	                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED - WS-STANDARD-HOURS
323	             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-PAY =
324	                 WS-REGULAR-HOURS * EMP-HOURLY-RATE
325	             EVALUATE TRUE
326	                 WHEN CATEGORY-A
327	                     MOVE 1.20 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
328	                 WHEN CATEGORY-B
329	                     MOVE 1.10 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
330	                 WHEN CATEGORY-C
331	                     MOVE 1.00 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
332	                 WHEN OTHER
333	                     MOVE 1.00 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
334	             END-EVALUATE
335	             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-RATE =
336	                 EMP-HOURLY-RATE * WS-BONUS-FACTOR
337	             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-PAY =
338	                 WS-OVERTIME-HOURS * WS-OVERTIME-RATE
339	             COMPUTE WS-GROSS-SALARY =
340	                 WS-REGULAR-PAY + WS-OVERTIME-PAY
341	         WHEN OTHER
342	             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-HOURS =
343	                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED
344	             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-PAY =
345	                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED * EMP-HOURLY-RATE
346	             MOVE WS-REGULAR-PAY TO WS-GROSS-SALARY
347	     END-EVALUATE.
348	
349	 2150-CALCULATE-DEDUCTIONS.
350	     COMPUTE WS-HEALTH-DEDUCTION ROUNDED =
351	         WS-GROSS-SALARY * WS-HEALTH-RATE
352	     COMPUTE WS-RETIRE-DEDUCTION ROUNDED =
353	         WS-GROSS-SALARY * WS-RETIRE-RATE
354	     COMPUTE WS-UNEMP-DEDUCTION  ROUNDED =
355	         WS-GROSS-SALARY * WS-UNEMP-RATE
356	     COMPUTE WS-TOTAL-DEDUCTION =
357	         WS-HEALTH-DEDUCTION + WS-RETIRE-DEDUCTION
358	         + WS-UNEMP-DEDUCTION
359	     COMPUTE WS-NET-SALARY =
360	         WS-GROSS-SALARY - WS-TOTAL-DEDUCTION.
361	
362	 2200-WRITE-PAYSLIP.
363	     MOVE EMP-ID           TO WSP-ID
364	     MOVE EMP-NAME         TO WSP-NAME
365	     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY     TO WSP-CATEGORY
366	     MOVE EMP-HOURS-WORKED TO WSP-HOURS
367	     MOVE EMP-HOURLY-RATE  TO WSP-RATE
368	     MOVE WS-REGULAR-PAY   TO WSP-REGULAR
369	     MOVE WS-OVERTIME-PAY  TO WSP-OVERTIME
370	     MOVE WS-GROSS-SALARY     TO WSP-GROSS
371	     MOVE WS-HEALTH-DEDUCTION TO WSP-HEALTH
372	     MOVE WS-RETIRE-DEDUCTION TO WSP-RETIREMENT
373	     MOVE WS-UNEMP-DEDUCTION  TO WSP-UNEMPLOYMENT
374	     MOVE WS-TOTAL-DEDUCTION  TO WSP-TOTAL-DED
375	     MOVE WS-NET-SALARY       TO WSP-NET
376	     WRITE PAYSLIP-RECORD FROM WS-PAYSLIP-LINE
377	     IF NOT PAY-FILE-OK
378	         DISPLAY "ERROR: Write error - Status: " WS-PAY-STATUS
379	     END-IF.
380	
381	 2300-DISPLAY-EMPLOYEE.
382	     MOVE EMP-ID           TO WSD-ID
383	     MOVE EMP-NAME         TO WSD-NAME
384	     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY     TO WSD-CATEGORY
385	     MOVE EMP-HOURS-WORKED TO WSD-HOURS
386	     MOVE EMP-HOURLY-RATE  TO WSD-RATE
387	     MOVE WS-GROSS-SALARY  TO WSD-GROSS
388	     MOVE WS-NET-SALARY    TO WSD-NET
389	     DISPLAY WS-DISPLAY-LINE.
390	
391	 2400-ACCUMULATE-CATEGORY.
392	     EVALUATE TRUE
393	         WHEN CATEGORY-A
394	             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-A-COUNT
395	             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-A-PAYROLL
396	         WHEN CATEGORY-B
397	             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-B-COUNT
398	             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-B-PAYROLL
399	         WHEN CATEGORY-C
400	             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-C-COUNT
401	             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-C-PAYROLL
402	         WHEN OTHER
403	             CONTINUE
404	     END-EVALUATE.
405	
406	 3000-FINALIZATION.
407	     PERFORM 3100-BUILD-CATEGORY-TABLE
408	     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
409	     MOVE WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES TO WS-TOT-EMP-DISP
410	     DISPLAY WS-TOTAL-DISP
411	     MOVE WS-TOTAL-REJECTED  TO WS-TOT-REJ-DISP
412	     DISPLAY WS-REJECTED-DISP
413	     MOVE WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL   TO WS-TOT-PAY-DISP
414	     DISPLAY WS-PAYROLL-DISP
415	     MOVE WS-TOTAL-NET       TO WS-TOT-NET-DISP
416	     DISPLAY WS-NET-PAYROLL-DISP
417	     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
418	     DISPLAY "           BREAKDOWN BY JOB CATEGORY               "
419	     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
420	     PERFORM 3200-DISPLAY-CATEGORY-SUMMARY
421	         VARYING WS-CAT-IDX FROM 1 BY 1
422	         UNTIL WS-CAT-IDX > 3
423	     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
424	     CLOSE EMPLOYEE-FILE
425	     CLOSE PAYSLIP-FILE
426	     CLOSE REJECT-FILE
427	     DISPLAY "JOB COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY".
428	
429	 3100-BUILD-CATEGORY-TABLE.
430	     MOVE "A"              TO WS-CAT-LABEL (1)
431	     MOVE WS-CAT-A-COUNT  TO WS-CAT-COUNT  (1)
432	     MOVE WS-CAT-A-PAYROLL TO WS-CAT-TOTAL (1)
433	     MOVE "B"              TO WS-CAT-LABEL (2)
434	     MOVE WS-CAT-B-COUNT  TO WS-CAT-COUNT  (2)
435	     MOVE WS-CAT-B-PAYROLL TO WS-CAT-TOTAL (2)
436	     MOVE "C"              TO WS-CAT-LABEL (3)
437	     MOVE WS-CAT-C-COUNT  TO WS-CAT-COUNT  (3)
438	     MOVE WS-CAT-C-PAYROLL TO WS-CAT-TOTAL (3).
439	
440	 3200-DISPLAY-CATEGORY-SUMMARY.
441	     MOVE WS-CAT-LABEL (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WCR-LABEL
442	     MOVE WS-CAT-COUNT (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WCR-COUNT
443	     MOVE WS-CAT-TOTAL (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WCR-TOTAL
444	     DISPLAY WS-CAT-REPORT-LINE.
445

file.content:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
 PROGRAM-ID. PAYROLL-SYSTEM.
 AUTHOR. PAYROLL-DEPT.

 ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
 CONFIGURATION SECTION.
 SOURCE-COMPUTER. LINUX.
 OBJECT-COMPUTER. LINUX.
 INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
 FILE-CONTROL.
     SELECT EMPLOYEE-FILE
         ASSIGN TO "employees_input.dat"
         ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL
         ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL
         FILE STATUS IS WS-EMP-STATUS.
     SELECT PAYSLIP-FILE
         ASSIGN TO "payslips_output.dat"
         ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL
         ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL
         FILE STATUS IS WS-PAY-STATUS.
     SELECT REJECT-FILE
         ASSIGN TO "rejects_output.dat"
         ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL
         ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL
         FILE STATUS IS WS-REJ-STATUS.

 DATA DIVISION.
 FILE SECTION.

 FD EMPLOYEE-FILE
     RECORD CONTAINS 37 CHARACTERS.
 01 EMPLOYEE-RECORD.
     05 EMP-ID              PIC 9(6).
     05 EMP-ID-X            REDEFINES EMP-ID PIC X(6).
     05 EMP-NAME            PIC X(20).
     05 EMP-CATEGORY        PIC X(1).
     05 EMP-HOURS-WORKED    PIC 9(3)V9(1).
     05 EMP-HOURLY-RATE     PIC 9(4)V9(2).

 FD PAYSLIP-FILE
     RECORD CONTAINS 123 CHARACTERS.
 01 PAYSLIP-RECORD          PIC X(123).

 FD REJECT-FILE
     RECORD CONTAINS 45 CHARACTERS.
 01 REJECT-RECORD           PIC X(45).

 WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.

 01 WS-FILE-STATUS.
     05 WS-EMP-STATUS       PIC X(2).
         88 EMP-FILE-OK     VALUE "00".
         88 EMP-EOF         VALUE "10".
     05 WS-PAY-STATUS       PIC X(2).
         88 PAY-FILE-OK     VALUE "00".
     05 WS-REJ-STATUS       PIC X(2).
         88 REJ-FILE-OK     VALUE "00".

 01 WS-FLAGS.
     05 WS-END-OF-FILE      PIC X(1) VALUE "N".
         88 END-OF-FILE     VALUE "Y".
         88 NOT-END-OF-FILE VALUE "N".

 01 WS-VALIDATION.
     05 WS-RECORD-VALID     PIC X(1) VALUE "Y".
         88 RECORD-VALID    VALUE "Y".
         88 RECORD-INVALID  VALUE "N".
     05 WS-VALIDATION-CODE  PIC X(7) VALUE SPACES.

 01 WS-COMPUTATION.
     05 WS-REGULAR-HOURS    PIC 9(3)V9(1) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-OVERTIME-HOURS   PIC 9(3)V9(1) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-REGULAR-PAY      PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-OVERTIME-PAY     PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-GROSS-SALARY     PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-OVERTIME-RATE    PIC 9(4)V9(4) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-BONUS-FACTOR     PIC 9(1)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-HEALTH-DEDUCTION PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-RETIRE-DEDUCTION PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-UNEMP-DEDUCTION  PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-TOTAL-DEDUCTION  PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-NET-SALARY       PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.

 01 WS-LIMITS.
     05 WS-STANDARD-HOURS   PIC 9(3)V9(1) VALUE 35.0.

 01 WS-CONTRIB-RATES.
     05 WS-HEALTH-RATE      PIC V9(4) VALUE .0730.
     05 WS-RETIRE-RATE      PIC V9(4) VALUE .0690.
     05 WS-UNEMP-RATE       PIC V9(4) VALUE .0240.

 01 WS-TOTALS.
     05 WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES  PIC 9(6) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-TOTAL-REJECTED   PIC 9(6) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL    PIC 9(9)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-TOTAL-NET        PIC 9(9)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.

 01 WS-CAT-SUBTOTALS.
     05 WS-CAT-A-COUNT      PIC 9(6) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-CAT-A-PAYROLL    PIC 9(9)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-CAT-B-COUNT      PIC 9(6) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-CAT-B-PAYROLL    PIC 9(9)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-CAT-C-COUNT      PIC 9(6) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-CAT-C-PAYROLL    PIC 9(9)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.

 01 WS-CATEGORY-TABLE.
     05 WS-CAT-ENTRY OCCURS 3 TIMES INDEXED BY WS-CAT-IDX.
         10 WS-CAT-LABEL    PIC X(1).
         10 WS-CAT-COUNT    PIC 9(6).
         10 WS-CAT-TOTAL    PIC 9(9)V9(2).

 01 WS-CAT-REPORT-LINE.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(9)  VALUE "CATEGORY ".
     05 WCR-LABEL           PIC X(1).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(13) VALUE " - EMPLOYEES:".
     05 WCR-COUNT           PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(9)  VALUE " PAYROLL:".
     05 WCR-TOTAL           PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.99.

 01 WS-LOOP-INDEX           PIC 9(2) VALUE 1.

 01 WS-CATEGORY-FLAGS.
     05 WS-CAT              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACES.
         88 CATEGORY-A      VALUE "A".
         88 CATEGORY-B      VALUE "B".
         88 CATEGORY-C      VALUE "C".

 01 WS-PAYSLIP-LINE.
     05 WSP-ID              PIC 9(6).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-NAME            PIC X(20).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-CATEGORY        PIC X(1).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-HOURS           PIC ZZZ.9.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-RATE            PIC ZZZZ.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-REGULAR         PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-OVERTIME        PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-GROSS           PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-HEALTH          PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-RETIREMENT      PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-UNEMPLOYMENT    PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-TOTAL-DED       PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-NET             PIC ZZZZZ9.99.

 01 WS-REJECT-LINE.
     05 WRJ-EMP-DATA        PIC X(37).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WRJ-ERROR-CODE      PIC X(7).

 01 WS-TOTAL-DISP.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(30)
         VALUE "EMPLOYEES VALID (PROCESSED) : ".
     05 WS-TOT-EMP-DISP     PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.

 01 WS-REJECTED-DISP.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(30)
         VALUE "EMPLOYEES REJECTED          : ".
     05 WS-TOT-REJ-DISP     PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.

 01 WS-PAYROLL-DISP.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(30)
         VALUE "TOTAL GROSS PAYROLL         : ".
     05 WS-TOT-PAY-DISP     PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.99.

 01 WS-NET-PAYROLL-DISP.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(30)
         VALUE "TOTAL NET PAYROLL           : ".
     05 WS-TOT-NET-DISP     PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.99.

 01 WS-SEPARATOR.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(60)
         VALUE "------------------------------------------------------------".

 01 WS-HEADER-LINE.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(60)
         VALUE "           PAYROLL PROCESSING REPORT                       ".

 01 WS-COL-HEADER.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(6)  VALUE "EMP-ID".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(2)  VALUE SPACES.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(20) VALUE "NAME                ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(4)  VALUE "CAT ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(8)  VALUE "HOURS   ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(8)  VALUE "RATE    ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(12) VALUE "GROSS SALARY".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(2)  VALUE SPACES.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(10) VALUE "NET SALARY".

 01 WS-DISPLAY-LINE.
     05 WSD-ID              PIC 9(6).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSD-NAME            PIC X(20).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSD-CATEGORY        PIC X(1).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSD-HOURS           PIC ZZ9.9.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSD-RATE            PIC ZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSD-GROSS           PIC ZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSD-NET             PIC ZZZZ9.99.

 PROCEDURE DIVISION.

 0000-MAIN-CONTROL.
     PERFORM 1000-INITIALIZATION
     PERFORM 2000-PROCESS-EMPLOYEES
         UNTIL END-OF-FILE
     PERFORM 3000-FINALIZATION
     STOP RUN.

 1000-INITIALIZATION.
     OPEN INPUT EMPLOYEE-FILE
     IF NOT EMP-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Cannot open employees_input.dat - Status: "
             WS-EMP-STATUS
         STOP RUN
     END-IF
     OPEN OUTPUT PAYSLIP-FILE
     IF NOT PAY-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Cannot open payslips_output.dat - Status: "
             WS-PAY-STATUS
         STOP RUN
     END-IF
     OPEN OUTPUT REJECT-FILE
     IF NOT REJ-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Cannot open rejects_output.dat - Status: "
             WS-REJ-STATUS
         STOP RUN
     END-IF
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     DISPLAY WS-HEADER-LINE
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     DISPLAY WS-COL-HEADER
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     PERFORM 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.

 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.
     READ EMPLOYEE-FILE INTO EMPLOYEE-RECORD
     IF EMP-EOF
         MOVE "Y" TO WS-END-OF-FILE
     ELSE
         IF NOT EMP-FILE-OK
             DISPLAY "ERROR: Read error - Status: " WS-EMP-STATUS
             MOVE "Y" TO WS-END-OF-FILE
         END-IF
     END-IF.

 2000-PROCESS-EMPLOYEES.
     PERFORM 1900-VALIDATE-RECORD
     IF RECORD-VALID
         PERFORM 2100-CALCULATE-SALARY
         PERFORM 2150-CALCULATE-DEDUCTIONS
         PERFORM 2200-WRITE-PAYSLIP
         PERFORM 2300-DISPLAY-EMPLOYEE
         ADD 1 TO WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES
         ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL
         ADD WS-NET-SALARY   TO WS-TOTAL-NET
         PERFORM 2400-ACCUMULATE-CATEGORY
     ELSE
         PERFORM 1950-WRITE-REJECT
     END-IF
     PERFORM 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.

 1900-VALIDATE-RECORD.
     MOVE "Y" TO WS-RECORD-VALID
     MOVE SPACES TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY TO WS-CAT
     EVALUATE TRUE
         WHEN EMP-ID-X = SPACES OR EMP-ID-X = "000000"
             MOVE "N"       TO WS-RECORD-VALID
             MOVE "ERR-001" TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
         WHEN EMP-HOURS-WORKED <= ZEROES
           OR EMP-HOURS-WORKED > 80
             MOVE "N"       TO WS-RECORD-VALID
             MOVE "ERR-002" TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
         WHEN EMP-HOURLY-RATE <= ZEROES
           OR EMP-HOURLY-RATE > 999.99
             MOVE "N"       TO WS-RECORD-VALID
             MOVE "ERR-003" TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
         WHEN NOT (CATEGORY-A OR CATEGORY-B OR CATEGORY-C)
             MOVE "N"       TO WS-RECORD-VALID
             MOVE "ERR-004" TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
     END-EVALUATE.

 1950-WRITE-REJECT.
     MOVE EMPLOYEE-RECORD   TO WRJ-EMP-DATA
     MOVE WS-VALIDATION-CODE TO WRJ-ERROR-CODE
     WRITE REJECT-RECORD FROM WS-REJECT-LINE
     IF NOT REJ-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Reject write error - Status: "
             WS-REJ-STATUS
     END-IF
     ADD 1 TO WS-TOTAL-REJECTED
     DISPLAY "REJECTED [" WS-VALIDATION-CODE "]: "
         EMP-ID SPACE EMP-NAME.

 2100-CALCULATE-SALARY.
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY TO WS-CAT
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-REGULAR-PAY
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-OVERTIME-PAY
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-GROSS-SALARY
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-OVERTIME-HOURS
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-REGULAR-HOURS
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
     EVALUATE TRUE
         WHEN EMP-HOURS-WORKED > WS-STANDARD-HOURS
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-HOURS =
                 WS-STANDARD-HOURS
             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-HOURS =
                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED - WS-STANDARD-HOURS
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-PAY =
                 WS-REGULAR-HOURS * EMP-HOURLY-RATE
             EVALUATE TRUE
                 WHEN CATEGORY-A
                     MOVE 1.20 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
                 WHEN CATEGORY-B
                     MOVE 1.10 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
                 WHEN CATEGORY-C
                     MOVE 1.00 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
                 WHEN OTHER
                     MOVE 1.00 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
             END-EVALUATE
             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-RATE =
                 EMP-HOURLY-RATE * WS-BONUS-FACTOR
             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-PAY =
                 WS-OVERTIME-HOURS * WS-OVERTIME-RATE
             COMPUTE WS-GROSS-SALARY =
                 WS-REGULAR-PAY + WS-OVERTIME-PAY
         WHEN OTHER
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-HOURS =
                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-PAY =
                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED * EMP-HOURLY-RATE
             MOVE WS-REGULAR-PAY TO WS-GROSS-SALARY
     END-EVALUATE.

 2150-CALCULATE-DEDUCTIONS.
     COMPUTE WS-HEALTH-DEDUCTION ROUNDED =
         WS-GROSS-SALARY * WS-HEALTH-RATE
     COMPUTE WS-RETIRE-DEDUCTION ROUNDED =
         WS-GROSS-SALARY * WS-RETIRE-RATE
     COMPUTE WS-UNEMP-DEDUCTION  ROUNDED =
         WS-GROSS-SALARY * WS-UNEMP-RATE
     COMPUTE WS-TOTAL-DEDUCTION =
         WS-HEALTH-DEDUCTION + WS-RETIRE-DEDUCTION
         + WS-UNEMP-DEDUCTION
     COMPUTE WS-NET-SALARY =
         WS-GROSS-SALARY - WS-TOTAL-DEDUCTION.

 2200-WRITE-PAYSLIP.
     MOVE EMP-ID           TO WSP-ID
     MOVE EMP-NAME         TO WSP-NAME
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY     TO WSP-CATEGORY
     MOVE EMP-HOURS-WORKED TO WSP-HOURS
     MOVE EMP-HOURLY-RATE  TO WSP-RATE
     MOVE WS-REGULAR-PAY   TO WSP-REGULAR
     MOVE WS-OVERTIME-PAY  TO WSP-OVERTIME
     MOVE WS-GROSS-SALARY     TO WSP-GROSS
     MOVE WS-HEALTH-DEDUCTION TO WSP-HEALTH
     MOVE WS-RETIRE-DEDUCTION TO WSP-RETIREMENT
     MOVE WS-UNEMP-DEDUCTION  TO WSP-UNEMPLOYMENT
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-DEDUCTION  TO WSP-TOTAL-DED
     MOVE WS-NET-SALARY       TO WSP-NET
     WRITE PAYSLIP-RECORD FROM WS-PAYSLIP-LINE
     IF NOT PAY-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Write error - Status: " WS-PAY-STATUS
     END-IF.

 2300-DISPLAY-EMPLOYEE.
     MOVE EMP-ID           TO WSD-ID
     MOVE EMP-NAME         TO WSD-NAME
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY     TO WSD-CATEGORY
     MOVE EMP-HOURS-WORKED TO WSD-HOURS
     MOVE EMP-HOURLY-RATE  TO WSD-RATE
     MOVE WS-GROSS-SALARY  TO WSD-GROSS
     MOVE WS-NET-SALARY    TO WSD-NET
     DISPLAY WS-DISPLAY-LINE.

 2400-ACCUMULATE-CATEGORY.
     EVALUATE TRUE
         WHEN CATEGORY-A
             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-A-COUNT
             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-A-PAYROLL
         WHEN CATEGORY-B
             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-B-COUNT
             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-B-PAYROLL
         WHEN CATEGORY-C
             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-C-COUNT
             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-C-PAYROLL
         WHEN OTHER
             CONTINUE
     END-EVALUATE.

 3000-FINALIZATION.

     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES TO WS-TOT-EMP-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-TOTAL-DISP
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-REJECTED  TO WS-TOT-REJ-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-REJECTED-DISP
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL   TO WS-TOT-PAY-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-PAYROLL-DISP
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-NET       TO WS-TOT-NET-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-NET-PAYROLL-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     DISPLAY "           BREAKDOWN BY JOB CATEGORY               "
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     PERFORM 3200-DISPLAY-CATEGORY-SUMMARY
         VARYING WS-CAT-IDX FROM 1 BY 1
         UNTIL WS-CAT-IDX > 3
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     CLOSE EMPLOYEE-FILE
     CLOSE PAYSLIP-FILE
     CLOSE REJECT-FILE
     DISPLAY "JOB COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY".

     MOVE "A"              TO WS-CAT-LABEL (1)
     MOVE WS-CAT-A-COUNT  TO WS-CAT-COUNT  (1)
     MOVE WS-CAT-A-PAYROLL TO WS-CAT-TOTAL (1)

     MOVE "C"              TO WS-CAT-LABEL (3)

156	     05 WSP-OVERTIME        PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
157	     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
158	     05 WSP-GROSS           PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
159	     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
160	     05 WSP-HEALTH          PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
161	     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
162	     05 WSP-RETIREMENT      PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
163	     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
164	     05 WSP-UNEMPLOYMENT    PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
165	     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
166	     05 WSP-TOTAL-DED       PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
167	     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
168	     05 WSP-NET             PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
169	
170	 01 WS-REJECT-LINE.
171	     05 WRJ-EMP-DATA        PIC X(37).
172	     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
173	     05 WRJ-ERROR-CODE      PIC X(7).
174	
175	 01 WS-RPT-HEADER.
176	     05 FILLER              PIC X(10) VALUE "CATEGORY  ".
177	     05 FILLER              PIC X(12) VALUE "EMPLOYEES   ".
178	     05 FILLER              PIC X(20) VALUE "GROSS PAYROLL       ".
179	     05 FILLER              PIC X(20) VALUE "NET PAYROLL         ".
180	     05 FILLER              PIC X(8)  VALUE SPACES.
181	
182	 01 WS-RPT-SEPARATOR.
183	     05 FILLER              PIC X(70)
184	         VALUE ALL "-".
185	
186	 01 WS-RPT-CAT-LINE.
187	     05 FILLER              PIC X(5)  VALUE "  ".
188	     05 WRC-LABEL           PIC X(1).
189	     05 FILLER              PIC X(4)  VALUE SPACES.
190	     05 WRC-COUNT           PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.
191	     05 FILLER              PIC X(2)  VALUE SPACES.
192	     05 WRC-GROSS           PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.99.
193	     05 FILLER              PIC X(2)  VALUE SPACES.
194	     05 WRC-NET             PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.99.
195	
196	 01 WS-RPT-GRAND-LINE.
197	     05 FILLER              PIC X(10) VALUE "TOTAL     ".
198	     05 WRG-COUNT           PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.
199	     05 FILLER              PIC X(2)  VALUE SPACES.
200	     05 WRG-GROSS           PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.99.
201	     05 FILLER              PIC X(2)  VALUE SPACES.
202	     05 WRG-NET             PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.99.
203	
204	 01 WS-TOTAL-DISP.
205	     05 FILLER              PIC X(30)
206	         VALUE "EMPLOYEES VALID (PROCESSED) : ".
207	     05 WS-TOT-EMP-DISP     PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.
208	
209	 01 WS-REJECTED-DISP.
210	     05 FILLER              PIC X(30)
211	         VALUE "EMPLOYEES REJECTED          : ".
212	     05 WS-TOT-REJ-DISP     PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.
213	
214	 01 WS-PAYROLL-DISP.
215	     05 FILLER              PIC X(30)
216	         VALUE "TOTAL GROSS PAYROLL         : ".
217	     05 WS-TOT-PAY-DISP     PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.99.
218	
219	 01 WS-NET-PAYROLL-DISP.
220	     05 FILLER              PIC X(30)
221	         VALUE "TOTAL NET PAYROLL           : ".
222	     05 WS-TOT-NET-DISP     PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.99.
223	
224	 01 WS-SEPARATOR.
225	     05 FILLER              PIC X(60)
226	         VALUE "------------------------------------------------------------".
227	
228	 01 WS-HEADER-LINE.
229	     05 FILLER              PIC X(60)
230	         VALUE "           PAYROLL PROCESSING REPORT                       ".
231	
232	 01 WS-COL-HEADER.
233	     05 FILLER              PIC X(6)  VALUE "EMP-ID".
234	     05 FILLER              PIC X(2)  VALUE SPACES.
235	     05 FILLER              PIC X(20) VALUE "NAME                ".
236	     05 FILLER              PIC X(4)  VALUE "CAT ".
237	     05 FILLER              PIC X(8)  VALUE "HOURS   ".
238	     05 FILLER              PIC X(8)  VALUE "RATE    ".
239	     05 FILLER              PIC X(12) VALUE "GROSS SALARY".
240	     05 FILLER              PIC X(2)  VALUE SPACES.
241	     05 FILLER              PIC X(10) VALUE "NET SALARY".
242	
243	 01 WS-DISPLAY-LINE.
244	     05 WSD-ID              PIC 9(6).
245	     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
246	     05 WSD-NAME            PIC X(20).
247	     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
248	     05 WSD-CATEGORY        PIC X(1).
249	     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
250	     05 WSD-HOURS           PIC ZZ9.9.
251	     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
252	     05 WSD-RATE            PIC ZZZ9.99.
253	     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
254	     05 WSD-GROSS           PIC ZZZZ9.99.
255	     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
256	     05 WSD-NET             PIC ZZZZ9.99.
257	
258	 PROCEDURE DIVISION.
259	
260	 0000-MAIN-CONTROL.
261	     PERFORM 1000-INITIALIZATION
262	     PERFORM 2000-PROCESS-EMPLOYEES
263	         UNTIL END-OF-FILE
264	     PERFORM 3000-FINALIZATION
265	     STOP RUN.
266	
267	 1000-INITIALIZATION.
268	     OPEN INPUT EMPLOYEE-FILE
269	     IF NOT EMP-FILE-OK
270	         DISPLAY "ERROR: Cannot open employees_input.dat - Status: "
271	             WS-EMP-STATUS
272	         STOP RUN
273	     END-IF
274	     OPEN OUTPUT PAYSLIP-FILE
275	     IF NOT PAY-FILE-OK
276	         DISPLAY "ERROR: Cannot open payslips_output.dat - Status: "
277	             WS-PAY-STATUS
278	         STOP RUN
279	     END-IF
280	     OPEN OUTPUT REJECT-FILE
281	     IF NOT REJ-FILE-OK
282	         DISPLAY "ERROR: Cannot open rejects_output.dat - Status: "
283	             WS-REJ-STATUS
284	         STOP RUN
285	     END-IF
286	     OPEN OUTPUT REPORT-FILE
287	     IF NOT RPT-FILE-OK
288	         DISPLAY "ERROR: Cannot open report_output.dat - Status: "
289	             WS-RPT-STATUS
290	         STOP RUN
291	     END-IF
292	     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
293	     DISPLAY WS-HEADER-LINE
294	     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
295	     DISPLAY WS-COL-HEADER
296	     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
297	     PERFORM 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.
298	
299	 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.
300	     READ EMPLOYEE-FILE INTO EMPLOYEE-RECORD
301	     IF EMP-EOF
302	         MOVE "Y" TO WS-END-OF-FILE
303	     ELSE
304	         IF NOT EMP-FILE-OK
305	             DISPLAY "ERROR: Read error - Status: " WS-EMP-STATUS
306	             MOVE "Y" TO WS-END-OF-FILE
307	         END-IF
308	     END-IF.
309	
310	 2000-PROCESS-EMPLOYEES.
311	     PERFORM 1900-VALIDATE-RECORD
312	     IF RECORD-VALID
313	         PERFORM 2100-CALCULATE-SALARY
314	         PERFORM 2150-CALCULATE-DEDUCTIONS
315	         PERFORM 2200-WRITE-PAYSLIP
316	         PERFORM 2300-DISPLAY-EMPLOYEE
317	         ADD 1 TO WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES
318	         ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL
319	         ADD WS-NET-SALARY   TO WS-TOTAL-NET
320	         PERFORM 2400-ACCUMULATE-CATEGORY
321	     ELSE
322	         PERFORM 1950-WRITE-REJECT
323	     END-IF
324	     PERFORM 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.
325	
326	 1900-VALIDATE-RECORD.
327	     MOVE "Y" TO WS-RECORD-VALID
328	     MOVE SPACES TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
329	     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY TO WS-CAT
330	     EVALUATE TRUE
331	         WHEN EMP-ID-X = SPACES OR EMP-ID-X = "000000"
332	             MOVE "N"       TO WS-RECORD-VALID
333	             MOVE "ERR-001" TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
334	         WHEN EMP-HOURS-WORKED <= ZEROES
335	           OR EMP-HOURS-WORKED > 80
336	             MOVE "N"       TO WS-RECORD-VALID
337	             MOVE "ERR-002" TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
338	         WHEN EMP-HOURLY-RATE <= ZEROES
339	           OR EMP-HOURLY-RATE > 999.99
340	             MOVE "N"       TO WS-RECORD-VALID
341	             MOVE "ERR-003" TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
342	         WHEN NOT (CATEGORY-A OR CATEGORY-B OR CATEGORY-C)
343	             MOVE "N"       TO WS-RECORD-VALID
344	             MOVE "ERR-004" TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
345	     END-EVALUATE.
346	
347	 1950-WRITE-REJECT.
348	     MOVE EMPLOYEE-RECORD   TO WRJ-EMP-DATA
349	     MOVE WS-VALIDATION-CODE TO WRJ-ERROR-CODE
350	     WRITE REJECT-RECORD FROM WS-REJECT-LINE
351	     IF NOT REJ-FILE-OK
352	         DISPLAY "ERROR: Reject write error - Status: "
353	             WS-REJ-STATUS
354	     END-IF
355	     ADD 1 TO WS-TOTAL-REJECTED
356	     DISPLAY "REJECTED [" WS-VALIDATION-CODE "]: "
357	         EMP-ID SPACE EMP-NAME.
358	
359	 2100-CALCULATE-SALARY.
360	     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY TO WS-CAT
361	     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-REGULAR-PAY
362	     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-OVERTIME-PAY
363	     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-GROSS-SALARY
364	     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-OVERTIME-HOURS
365	     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-REGULAR-HOURS
366	     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
367	     EVALUATE TRUE
368	         WHEN EMP-HOURS-WORKED > WS-STANDARD-HOURS
369	             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-HOURS =
370	                 WS-STANDARD-HOURS
371	             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-HOURS =
372	                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED - WS-STANDARD-HOURS
373	             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-PAY =
374	                 WS-REGULAR-HOURS * EMP-HOURLY-RATE
375	             EVALUATE TRUE
376	                 WHEN CATEGORY-A
377	                     MOVE 1.20 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
378	                 WHEN CATEGORY-B
379	                     MOVE 1.10 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
380	                 WHEN CATEGORY-C
381	                     MOVE 1.00 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
382	                 WHEN OTHER
383	                     MOVE 1.00 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
384	             END-EVALUATE
385	             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-RATE =
386	                 EMP-HOURLY-RATE * WS-BONUS-FACTOR
387	             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-PAY =
388	                 WS-OVERTIME-HOURS * WS-OVERTIME-RATE
389	             COMPUTE WS-GROSS-SALARY =
390	                 WS-REGULAR-PAY + WS-OVERTIME-PAY
391	         WHEN OTHER
392	             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-HOURS =
393	                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED
394	             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-PAY =
395	                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED * EMP-HOURLY-RATE
396	             MOVE WS-REGULAR-PAY TO WS-GROSS-SALARY
397	     END-EVALUATE.
398	
399	 2150-CALCULATE-DEDUCTIONS.
400	     COMPUTE WS-HEALTH-DEDUCTION ROUNDED =
401	         WS-GROSS-SALARY * WS-HEALTH-RATE
402	     COMPUTE WS-RETIRE-DEDUCTION ROUNDED =
403	         WS-GROSS-SALARY * WS-RETIRE-RATE
404	     COMPUTE WS-UNEMP-DEDUCTION  ROUNDED =
405	         WS-GROSS-SALARY * WS-UNEMP-RATE
406	     COMPUTE WS-TOTAL-DEDUCTION =
407	         WS-HEALTH-DEDUCTION + WS-RETIRE-DEDUCTION
408	         + WS-UNEMP-DEDUCTION
409	     COMPUTE WS-NET-SALARY =
410	         WS-GROSS-SALARY - WS-TOTAL-DEDUCTION.
411	
412	 2200-WRITE-PAYSLIP.
413	     MOVE EMP-ID           TO WSP-ID
414	     MOVE EMP-NAME         TO WSP-NAME
415	     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY     TO WSP-CATEGORY
416	     MOVE EMP-HOURS-WORKED TO WSP-HOURS
417	     MOVE EMP-HOURLY-RATE  TO WSP-RATE
418	     MOVE WS-REGULAR-PAY   TO WSP-REGULAR
419	     MOVE WS-OVERTIME-PAY  TO WSP-OVERTIME
420	     MOVE WS-GROSS-SALARY     TO WSP-GROSS
421	     MOVE WS-HEALTH-DEDUCTION TO WSP-HEALTH
422	     MOVE WS-RETIRE-DEDUCTION TO WSP-RETIREMENT
423	     MOVE WS-UNEMP-DEDUCTION  TO WSP-UNEMPLOYMENT
424	     MOVE WS-TOTAL-DEDUCTION  TO WSP-TOTAL-DED
425	     MOVE WS-NET-SALARY       TO WSP-NET
426	     WRITE PAYSLIP-RECORD FROM WS-PAYSLIP-LINE
427	     IF NOT PAY-FILE-OK
428	         DISPLAY "ERROR: Write error - Status: " WS-PAY-STATUS
429	     END-IF.
430	
431	 2300-DISPLAY-EMPLOYEE.
432	     MOVE EMP-ID           TO WSD-ID
433	     MOVE EMP-NAME         TO WSD-NAME
434	     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY     TO WSD-CATEGORY
435	     MOVE EMP-HOURS-WORKED TO WSD-HOURS
436	     MOVE EMP-HOURLY-RATE  TO WSD-RATE
437	     MOVE WS-GROSS-SALARY  TO WSD-GROSS
438	     MOVE WS-NET-SALARY    TO WSD-NET
439	     DISPLAY WS-DISPLAY-LINE.
440	
441	 2400-ACCUMULATE-CATEGORY.
442	     EVALUATE TRUE
443	         WHEN CATEGORY-A
444	             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-A-COUNT
445	             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-A-PAYROLL
446	             ADD WS-NET-SALARY   TO WS-CAT-A-NET
447	         WHEN CATEGORY-B
448	             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-B-COUNT
449	             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-B-PAYROLL
450	             ADD WS-NET-SALARY   TO WS-CAT-B-NET
451	         WHEN CATEGORY-C
452	             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-C-COUNT
453	             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-C-PAYROLL
454	             ADD WS-NET-SALARY   TO WS-CAT-C-NET
455	         WHEN OTHER
456	             CONTINUE
457	     END-EVALUATE.
458	
459	 3000-FINALIZATION.
460	     PERFORM 3100-BUILD-CATEGORY-TABLE
461	     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
462	     MOVE WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES TO WS-TOT-EMP-DISP
463	     DISPLAY WS-TOTAL-DISP
464	     MOVE WS-TOTAL-REJECTED  TO WS-TOT-REJ-DISP
465	     DISPLAY WS-REJECTED-DISP
466	     MOVE WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL   TO WS-TOT-PAY-DISP
467	     DISPLAY WS-PAYROLL-DISP
468	     MOVE WS-TOTAL-NET       TO WS-TOT-NET-DISP
469	     DISPLAY WS-NET-PAYROLL-DISP
470	     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
471	     DISPLAY "           BREAKDOWN BY JOB CATEGORY               "
472	     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
473	     PERFORM 3200-DISPLAY-CATEGORY-SUMMARY
474	         VARYING WS-CAT-IDX FROM 1 BY 1
475	         UNTIL WS-CAT-IDX > 3
476	     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
477	     PERFORM 3300-WRITE-REPORT-FILE
478	     CLOSE EMPLOYEE-FILE
479	     CLOSE PAYSLIP-FILE
480	     CLOSE REJECT-FILE
481	     CLOSE REPORT-FILE
482	     DISPLAY "JOB COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY".
483	
484	 3100-BUILD-CATEGORY-TABLE.
485	     MOVE "A"              TO WS-CAT-LABEL   (1)
486	     MOVE WS-CAT-A-COUNT  TO WS-CAT-COUNT   (1)
487	     MOVE WS-CAT-A-PAYROLL TO WS-CAT-TOTAL  (1)
488	     MOVE WS-CAT-A-NET    TO WS-CAT-NET-TOT (1)
489	     MOVE "B"              TO WS-CAT-LABEL   (2)
490	     MOVE WS-CAT-B-COUNT  TO WS-CAT-COUNT   (2)
491	     MOVE WS-CAT-B-PAYROLL TO WS-CAT-TOTAL  (2)
492	     MOVE WS-CAT-B-NET    TO WS-CAT-NET-TOT (2)
493	     MOVE "C"              TO WS-CAT-LABEL   (3)
494	     MOVE WS-CAT-C-COUNT  TO WS-CAT-COUNT   (3)
495	     MOVE WS-CAT-C-PAYROLL TO WS-CAT-TOTAL  (3)
496	     MOVE WS-CAT-C-NET    TO WS-CAT-NET-TOT (3).
497	
498	 3200-DISPLAY-CATEGORY-SUMMARY.
499	     MOVE WS-CAT-LABEL (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WCR-LABEL
500	     MOVE WS-CAT-COUNT (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WCR-COUNT
501	     MOVE WS-CAT-TOTAL (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WCR-TOTAL
502	     DISPLAY WS-CAT-REPORT-LINE.
503	
504	 3300-WRITE-REPORT-FILE.
505	     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-HEADER
506	     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-SEPARATOR
507	     PERFORM 3350-WRITE-REPORT-CAT-LINE
508	         VARYING WS-CAT-IDX FROM 1 BY 1
509	         UNTIL WS-CAT-IDX > 3
510	     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-SEPARATOR
511	     PERFORM 3400-WRITE-GRAND-TOTAL
512	     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-SEPARATOR.
513	
514	 3350-WRITE-REPORT-CAT-LINE.
515	     MOVE WS-CAT-LABEL   (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WRC-LABEL
516	     MOVE WS-CAT-COUNT   (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WRC-COUNT
517	     MOVE WS-CAT-TOTAL   (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WRC-GROSS
518	     MOVE WS-CAT-NET-TOT (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WRC-NET
519	     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-CAT-LINE
520	     IF NOT RPT-FILE-OK
521	         DISPLAY "ERROR: Report write error - Status: "
522	             WS-RPT-STATUS
523	     END-IF.
524	
525	 3400-WRITE-GRAND-TOTAL.
526	     MOVE WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES TO WRG-COUNT
527	     MOVE WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL   TO WRG-GROSS
528	     MOVE WS-TOTAL-NET       TO WRG-NET
529	     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-GRAND-LINE
530	     IF NOT RPT-FILE-OK
531	         DISPLAY "ERROR: Report write error - Status: "
532	             WS-RPT-STATUS
533	     END-IF.

file.content:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
 PROGRAM-ID. PAYROLL-SYSTEM.
 AUTHOR. PAYROLL-DEPT.

 ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
 CONFIGURATION SECTION.
 SOURCE-COMPUTER. LINUX.
 OBJECT-COMPUTER. LINUX.
 INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
 FILE-CONTROL.
     SELECT EMPLOYEE-FILE
         ASSIGN TO "employees_input.dat"
         ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL
         ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL
         FILE STATUS IS WS-EMP-STATUS.
     SELECT PAYSLIP-FILE
         ASSIGN TO "payslips_output.dat"
         ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL
         ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL
         FILE STATUS IS WS-PAY-STATUS.
     SELECT REJECT-FILE
         ASSIGN TO "rejects_output.dat"
         ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL
         ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL
         FILE STATUS IS WS-REJ-STATUS.
     SELECT REPORT-FILE
         ASSIGN TO "report_output.dat"
         ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL
         ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL
         FILE STATUS IS WS-RPT-STATUS.

 DATA DIVISION.
 FILE SECTION.

 FD EMPLOYEE-FILE
     RECORD CONTAINS 37 CHARACTERS.
 01 EMPLOYEE-RECORD.
     05 EMP-ID              PIC 9(6).
     05 EMP-ID-X            REDEFINES EMP-ID PIC X(6).
     05 EMP-NAME            PIC X(20).
     05 EMP-CATEGORY        PIC X(1).
     05 EMP-HOURS-WORKED    PIC 9(3)V9(1).
     05 EMP-HOURLY-RATE     PIC 9(4)V9(2).

 FD PAYSLIP-FILE
     RECORD CONTAINS 123 CHARACTERS.
 01 PAYSLIP-RECORD          PIC X(123).

 FD REJECT-FILE
     RECORD CONTAINS 45 CHARACTERS.
 01 REJECT-RECORD           PIC X(45).

 FD REPORT-FILE
     RECORD CONTAINS 70 CHARACTERS.
 01 REPORT-RECORD            PIC X(70).

 WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.

 01 WS-FILE-STATUS.
     05 WS-EMP-STATUS       PIC X(2).
         88 EMP-FILE-OK     VALUE "00".
         88 EMP-EOF         VALUE "10".
     05 WS-PAY-STATUS       PIC X(2).
         88 PAY-FILE-OK     VALUE "00".
     05 WS-REJ-STATUS       PIC X(2).
         88 REJ-FILE-OK     VALUE "00".
     05 WS-RPT-STATUS       PIC X(2).
         88 RPT-FILE-OK     VALUE "00".

 01 WS-FLAGS.
     05 WS-END-OF-FILE      PIC X(1) VALUE "N".
         88 END-OF-FILE     VALUE "Y".
         88 NOT-END-OF-FILE VALUE "N".

 01 WS-VALIDATION.
     05 WS-RECORD-VALID     PIC X(1) VALUE "Y".
         88 RECORD-VALID    VALUE "Y".
         88 RECORD-INVALID  VALUE "N".
     05 WS-VALIDATION-CODE  PIC X(7) VALUE SPACES.

 01 WS-COMPUTATION.
     05 WS-REGULAR-HOURS    PIC 9(3)V9(1) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-OVERTIME-HOURS   PIC 9(3)V9(1) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-REGULAR-PAY      PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-OVERTIME-PAY     PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-GROSS-SALARY     PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-OVERTIME-RATE    PIC 9(4)V9(4) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-BONUS-FACTOR     PIC 9(1)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-HEALTH-DEDUCTION PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-RETIRE-DEDUCTION PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-UNEMP-DEDUCTION  PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-TOTAL-DEDUCTION  PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-NET-SALARY       PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.

 01 WS-LIMITS.
     05 WS-STANDARD-HOURS   PIC 9(3)V9(1) VALUE 35.0.

 01 WS-CONTRIB-RATES.
     05 WS-HEALTH-RATE      PIC V9(4) VALUE .0730.
     05 WS-RETIRE-RATE      PIC V9(4) VALUE .0690.
     05 WS-UNEMP-RATE       PIC V9(4) VALUE .0240.

 01 WS-TOTALS.
     05 WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES  PIC 9(6) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-TOTAL-REJECTED   PIC 9(6) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL    PIC 9(9)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-TOTAL-NET        PIC 9(9)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.

 01 WS-CAT-SUBTOTALS.
     05 WS-CAT-A-COUNT      PIC 9(6) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-CAT-A-PAYROLL    PIC 9(9)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-CAT-A-NET        PIC 9(9)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-CAT-B-COUNT      PIC 9(6) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-CAT-B-PAYROLL    PIC 9(9)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-CAT-B-NET        PIC 9(9)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-CAT-C-COUNT      PIC 9(6) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-CAT-C-PAYROLL    PIC 9(9)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-CAT-C-NET        PIC 9(9)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.

 01 WS-CATEGORY-TABLE.
     05 WS-CAT-ENTRY OCCURS 3 TIMES INDEXED BY WS-CAT-IDX.
         10 WS-CAT-LABEL    PIC X(1).

         10 WS-CAT-NET-TOT  PIC 9(9)V9(2).

 01 WS-CAT-REPORT-LINE.

     05 FILLER              PIC X(13) VALUE " - EMPLOYEES:".
     05 WCR-COUNT           PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(9)  VALUE " PAYROLL:".

 01 WS-LOOP-INDEX           PIC 9(2) VALUE 1.

 01 WS-CATEGORY-FLAGS.
     05 WS-CAT              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACES.
         88 CATEGORY-A      VALUE "A".
         88 CATEGORY-B      VALUE "B".
         88 CATEGORY-C      VALUE "C".

 01 WS-PAYSLIP-LINE.
     05 WSP-ID              PIC 9(6).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-NAME            PIC X(20).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-CATEGORY        PIC X(1).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-HOURS           PIC ZZZ.9.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-RATE            PIC ZZZZ.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-REGULAR         PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-OVERTIME        PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-GROSS           PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-HEALTH          PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-RETIREMENT      PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-UNEMPLOYMENT    PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-TOTAL-DED       PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-NET             PIC ZZZZZ9.99.

 01 WS-REJECT-LINE.
     05 WRJ-EMP-DATA        PIC X(37).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WRJ-ERROR-CODE      PIC X(7).

 01 WS-RPT-HEADER.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(10) VALUE "CATEGORY  ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(12) VALUE "EMPLOYEES   ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(20) VALUE "GROSS PAYROLL       ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(20) VALUE "NET PAYROLL         ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(8)  VALUE SPACES.

 01 WS-RPT-SEPARATOR.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(70)
         VALUE ALL "-".

 01 WS-RPT-CAT-LINE.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(5)  VALUE "  ".
     05 WRC-LABEL           PIC X(1).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(4)  VALUE SPACES.
     05 WRC-COUNT           PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(2)  VALUE SPACES.
     05 WRC-GROSS           PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(2)  VALUE SPACES.
     05 WRC-NET             PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.99.

 01 WS-RPT-GRAND-LINE.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(10) VALUE "TOTAL     ".
     05 WRG-COUNT           PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(2)  VALUE SPACES.
     05 WRG-GROSS           PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(2)  VALUE SPACES.
     05 WRG-NET             PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.99.

 01 WS-TOTAL-DISP.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(30)
         VALUE "EMPLOYEES VALID (PROCESSED) : ".
     05 WS-TOT-EMP-DISP     PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.

 01 WS-REJECTED-DISP.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(30)
         VALUE "EMPLOYEES REJECTED          : ".
     05 WS-TOT-REJ-DISP     PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.

 01 WS-PAYROLL-DISP.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(30)
         VALUE "TOTAL GROSS PAYROLL         : ".
     05 WS-TOT-PAY-DISP     PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.99.

 01 WS-NET-PAYROLL-DISP.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(30)
         VALUE "TOTAL NET PAYROLL           : ".
     05 WS-TOT-NET-DISP     PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.99.

 01 WS-SEPARATOR.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(60)
         VALUE "------------------------------------------------------------".

 01 WS-HEADER-LINE.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(60)
         VALUE "           PAYROLL PROCESSING REPORT                       ".

 01 WS-COL-HEADER.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(6)  VALUE "EMP-ID".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(2)  VALUE SPACES.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(20) VALUE "NAME                ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(4)  VALUE "CAT ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(8)  VALUE "HOURS   ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(8)  VALUE "RATE    ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(12) VALUE "GROSS SALARY".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(2)  VALUE SPACES.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(10) VALUE "NET SALARY".

 01 WS-DISPLAY-LINE.
     05 WSD-ID              PIC 9(6).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSD-NAME            PIC X(20).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSD-CATEGORY        PIC X(1).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSD-HOURS           PIC ZZ9.9.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSD-RATE            PIC ZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSD-GROSS           PIC ZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSD-NET             PIC ZZZZ9.99.

 PROCEDURE DIVISION.

 0000-MAIN-CONTROL.
     PERFORM 1000-INITIALIZATION
     PERFORM 2000-PROCESS-EMPLOYEES
         UNTIL END-OF-FILE
     PERFORM 3000-FINALIZATION
     STOP RUN.

 1000-INITIALIZATION.
     OPEN INPUT EMPLOYEE-FILE
     IF NOT EMP-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Cannot open employees_input.dat - Status: "
             WS-EMP-STATUS
         STOP RUN
     END-IF
     OPEN OUTPUT PAYSLIP-FILE
     IF NOT PAY-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Cannot open payslips_output.dat - Status: "
             WS-PAY-STATUS
         STOP RUN
     END-IF
     OPEN OUTPUT REJECT-FILE
     IF NOT REJ-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Cannot open rejects_output.dat - Status: "
             WS-REJ-STATUS
         STOP RUN
     END-IF
     OPEN OUTPUT REPORT-FILE
     IF NOT RPT-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Cannot open report_output.dat - Status: "
             WS-RPT-STATUS
         STOP RUN
     END-IF
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     DISPLAY WS-HEADER-LINE
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     DISPLAY WS-COL-HEADER
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     PERFORM 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.

 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.
     READ EMPLOYEE-FILE INTO EMPLOYEE-RECORD
     IF EMP-EOF
         MOVE "Y" TO WS-END-OF-FILE
     ELSE
         IF NOT EMP-FILE-OK
             DISPLAY "ERROR: Read error - Status: " WS-EMP-STATUS
             MOVE "Y" TO WS-END-OF-FILE
         END-IF
     END-IF.

 2000-PROCESS-EMPLOYEES.
     PERFORM 1900-VALIDATE-RECORD
     IF RECORD-VALID
         PERFORM 2100-CALCULATE-SALARY
         PERFORM 2150-CALCULATE-DEDUCTIONS
         PERFORM 2200-WRITE-PAYSLIP
         PERFORM 2300-DISPLAY-EMPLOYEE
         ADD 1 TO WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES
         ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL
         ADD WS-NET-SALARY   TO WS-TOTAL-NET
         PERFORM 2400-ACCUMULATE-CATEGORY
     ELSE
         PERFORM 1950-WRITE-REJECT
     END-IF
     PERFORM 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.

 1900-VALIDATE-RECORD.
     MOVE "Y" TO WS-RECORD-VALID
     MOVE SPACES TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY TO WS-CAT
     EVALUATE TRUE
         WHEN EMP-ID-X = SPACES OR EMP-ID-X = "000000"
             MOVE "N"       TO WS-RECORD-VALID
             MOVE "ERR-001" TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
         WHEN EMP-HOURS-WORKED <= ZEROES
           OR EMP-HOURS-WORKED > 80
             MOVE "N"       TO WS-RECORD-VALID
             MOVE "ERR-002" TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
         WHEN EMP-HOURLY-RATE <= ZEROES
           OR EMP-HOURLY-RATE > 999.99
             MOVE "N"       TO WS-RECORD-VALID
             MOVE "ERR-003" TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
         WHEN NOT (CATEGORY-A OR CATEGORY-B OR CATEGORY-C)
             MOVE "N"       TO WS-RECORD-VALID
             MOVE "ERR-004" TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
     END-EVALUATE.

 1950-WRITE-REJECT.
     MOVE EMPLOYEE-RECORD   TO WRJ-EMP-DATA
     MOVE WS-VALIDATION-CODE TO WRJ-ERROR-CODE
     WRITE REJECT-RECORD FROM WS-REJECT-LINE
     IF NOT REJ-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Reject write error - Status: "
             WS-REJ-STATUS
     END-IF
     ADD 1 TO WS-TOTAL-REJECTED
     DISPLAY "REJECTED [" WS-VALIDATION-CODE "]: "
         EMP-ID SPACE EMP-NAME.

 2100-CALCULATE-SALARY.
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY TO WS-CAT
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-REGULAR-PAY
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-OVERTIME-PAY
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-GROSS-SALARY
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-OVERTIME-HOURS
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-REGULAR-HOURS
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
     EVALUATE TRUE
         WHEN EMP-HOURS-WORKED > WS-STANDARD-HOURS
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-HOURS =
                 WS-STANDARD-HOURS
             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-HOURS =
                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED - WS-STANDARD-HOURS
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-PAY =
                 WS-REGULAR-HOURS * EMP-HOURLY-RATE
             EVALUATE TRUE
                 WHEN CATEGORY-A
                     MOVE 1.20 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
                 WHEN CATEGORY-B
                     MOVE 1.10 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
                 WHEN CATEGORY-C
                     MOVE 1.00 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
                 WHEN OTHER
                     MOVE 1.00 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
             END-EVALUATE
             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-RATE =
                 EMP-HOURLY-RATE * WS-BONUS-FACTOR
             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-PAY =
                 WS-OVERTIME-HOURS * WS-OVERTIME-RATE
             COMPUTE WS-GROSS-SALARY =
                 WS-REGULAR-PAY + WS-OVERTIME-PAY
         WHEN OTHER
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-HOURS =
                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-PAY =
                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED * EMP-HOURLY-RATE
             MOVE WS-REGULAR-PAY TO WS-GROSS-SALARY
     END-EVALUATE.

 2150-CALCULATE-DEDUCTIONS.
     COMPUTE WS-HEALTH-DEDUCTION ROUNDED =
         WS-GROSS-SALARY * WS-HEALTH-RATE
     COMPUTE WS-RETIRE-DEDUCTION ROUNDED =
         WS-GROSS-SALARY * WS-RETIRE-RATE
     COMPUTE WS-UNEMP-DEDUCTION  ROUNDED =
         WS-GROSS-SALARY * WS-UNEMP-RATE
     COMPUTE WS-TOTAL-DEDUCTION =
         WS-HEALTH-DEDUCTION + WS-RETIRE-DEDUCTION
         + WS-UNEMP-DEDUCTION
     COMPUTE WS-NET-SALARY =
         WS-GROSS-SALARY - WS-TOTAL-DEDUCTION.

 2200-WRITE-PAYSLIP.
     MOVE EMP-ID           TO WSP-ID
     MOVE EMP-NAME         TO WSP-NAME
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY     TO WSP-CATEGORY
     MOVE EMP-HOURS-WORKED TO WSP-HOURS
     MOVE EMP-HOURLY-RATE  TO WSP-RATE
     MOVE WS-REGULAR-PAY   TO WSP-REGULAR
     MOVE WS-OVERTIME-PAY  TO WSP-OVERTIME
     MOVE WS-GROSS-SALARY     TO WSP-GROSS
     MOVE WS-HEALTH-DEDUCTION TO WSP-HEALTH
     MOVE WS-RETIRE-DEDUCTION TO WSP-RETIREMENT
     MOVE WS-UNEMP-DEDUCTION  TO WSP-UNEMPLOYMENT
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-DEDUCTION  TO WSP-TOTAL-DED
     MOVE WS-NET-SALARY       TO WSP-NET
     WRITE PAYSLIP-RECORD FROM WS-PAYSLIP-LINE
     IF NOT PAY-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Write error - Status: " WS-PAY-STATUS
     END-IF.

 2300-DISPLAY-EMPLOYEE.
     MOVE EMP-ID           TO WSD-ID
     MOVE EMP-NAME         TO WSD-NAME
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY     TO WSD-CATEGORY
     MOVE EMP-HOURS-WORKED TO WSD-HOURS
     MOVE EMP-HOURLY-RATE  TO WSD-RATE
     MOVE WS-GROSS-SALARY  TO WSD-GROSS
     MOVE WS-NET-SALARY    TO WSD-NET
     DISPLAY WS-DISPLAY-LINE.

 2400-ACCUMULATE-CATEGORY.
     EVALUATE TRUE
         WHEN CATEGORY-A
             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-A-COUNT
             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-A-PAYROLL
             ADD WS-NET-SALARY   TO WS-CAT-A-NET
         WHEN CATEGORY-B
             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-B-COUNT
             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-B-PAYROLL
             ADD WS-NET-SALARY   TO WS-CAT-B-NET
         WHEN CATEGORY-C
             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-C-COUNT
             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-C-PAYROLL
             ADD WS-NET-SALARY   TO WS-CAT-C-NET
         WHEN OTHER
             CONTINUE
     END-EVALUATE.

 3000-FINALIZATION.
     PERFORM 3100-BUILD-CATEGORY-TABLE
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES TO WS-TOT-EMP-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-TOTAL-DISP
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-REJECTED  TO WS-TOT-REJ-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-REJECTED-DISP
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL   TO WS-TOT-PAY-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-PAYROLL-DISP
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-NET       TO WS-TOT-NET-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-NET-PAYROLL-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     DISPLAY "           BREAKDOWN BY JOB CATEGORY               "
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     PERFORM 3200-DISPLAY-CATEGORY-SUMMARY
         VARYING WS-CAT-IDX FROM 1 BY 1
         UNTIL WS-CAT-IDX > 3
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     PERFORM 3300-WRITE-REPORT-FILE
     CLOSE EMPLOYEE-FILE
     CLOSE PAYSLIP-FILE
     CLOSE REJECT-FILE
     CLOSE REPORT-FILE
     DISPLAY "JOB COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY".

 3100-BUILD-CATEGORY-TABLE.
     MOVE "A"              TO WS-CAT-LABEL   (1)
     MOVE WS-CAT-A-COUNT  TO WS-CAT-COUNT   (1)
     MOVE WS-CAT-A-PAYROLL TO WS-CAT-TOTAL  (1)
     MOVE WS-CAT-A-NET    TO WS-CAT-NET-TOT (1)
     MOVE "B"              TO WS-CAT-LABEL   (2)
     MOVE WS-CAT-B-COUNT  TO WS-CAT-COUNT   (2)
     MOVE WS-CAT-B-PAYROLL TO WS-CAT-TOTAL  (2)
     MOVE WS-CAT-B-NET    TO WS-CAT-NET-TOT (2)
     MOVE "C"              TO WS-CAT-LABEL   (3)
     MOVE WS-CAT-C-COUNT  TO WS-CAT-COUNT   (3)
     MOVE WS-CAT-C-PAYROLL TO WS-CAT-TOTAL  (3)
     MOVE WS-CAT-C-NET    TO WS-CAT-NET-TOT (3).

 3200-DISPLAY-CATEGORY-SUMMARY.
     MOVE WS-CAT-LABEL (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WCR-LABEL
     MOVE WS-CAT-COUNT (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WCR-COUNT
     MOVE WS-CAT-TOTAL (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WCR-TOTAL
     DISPLAY WS-CAT-REPORT-LINE.

 3300-WRITE-REPORT-FILE.
     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-HEADER
     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-SEPARATOR
     PERFORM 3350-WRITE-REPORT-CAT-LINE
         VARYING WS-CAT-IDX FROM 1 BY 1
         UNTIL WS-CAT-IDX > 3
     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-SEPARATOR
     PERFORM 3400-WRITE-GRAND-TOTAL
     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-SEPARATOR.

 3350-WRITE-REPORT-CAT-LINE.
     MOVE WS-CAT-LABEL   (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WRC-LABEL
     MOVE WS-CAT-COUNT   (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WRC-COUNT
     MOVE WS-CAT-TOTAL   (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WRC-GROSS
     MOVE WS-CAT-NET-TOT (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WRC-NET
     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-CAT-LINE
     IF NOT RPT-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Report write error - Status: "
             WS-RPT-STATUS
     END-IF.

 3400-WRITE-GRAND-TOTAL.
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES TO WRG-COUNT
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL   TO WRG-GROSS
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-NET       TO WRG-NET
     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-GRAND-LINE
     IF NOT RPT-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Report write error - Status: "
             WS-RPT-STATUS
     END-IF.
