397	         WHEN EMP-HOURS-WORKED <= ZEROES
398	           OR EMP-HOURS-WORKED > 80
399	             MOVE "N"       TO WS-RECORD-VALID
400	             MOVE "ERR-002" TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
401	         WHEN EMP-HOURLY-RATE <= ZEROES
402	           OR EMP-HOURLY-RATE > 999.99
403	             MOVE "N"       TO WS-RECORD-VALID
404	             MOVE "ERR-003" TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
405	         WHEN NOT (CATEGORY-A OR CATEGORY-B OR CATEGORY-C)
406	             MOVE "N"       TO WS-RECORD-VALID
407	             MOVE "ERR-004" TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
408	     END-EVALUATE.
409	
410	 1950-WRITE-REJECT.
411	     MOVE EMPLOYEE-RECORD   TO WRJ-EMP-DATA
412	     MOVE WS-VALIDATION-CODE TO WRJ-ERROR-CODE
413	     WRITE REJECT-RECORD FROM WS-REJECT-LINE
414	     IF NOT REJ-FILE-OK
415	         DISPLAY "ERROR: Reject write error - Status: "
416	             WS-REJ-STATUS
417	     END-IF
418	     ADD 1 TO WS-TOTAL-REJECTED
419	     DISPLAY "REJECTED [" WS-VALIDATION-CODE "]: "
420	         EMP-ID SPACE EMP-NAME.
421	
422	 2100-CALCULATE-SALARY.
423	     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY TO WS-CAT
424	     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-REGULAR-PAY
425	     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-OVERTIME-PAY
426	     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-GROSS-SALARY
427	     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-OVERTIME-HOURS
428	     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-REGULAR-HOURS
429	     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
430	     EVALUATE TRUE
431	         WHEN EMP-HOURS-WORKED > WS-STANDARD-HOURS
432	             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-HOURS =
433	                 WS-STANDARD-HOURS
434	             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-HOURS =
435	                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED - WS-STANDARD-HOURS
436	             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-PAY =
437	                 WS-REGULAR-HOURS * EMP-HOURLY-RATE
438	             EVALUATE TRUE
439	                 WHEN CATEGORY-A
440	                     MOVE 1.20 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
441	                 WHEN CATEGORY-B
442	                     MOVE 1.10 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
443	                 WHEN CATEGORY-C
444	                     MOVE 1.00 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
445	                 WHEN OTHER
446	                     MOVE 1.00 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
447	             END-EVALUATE
448	             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-RATE =
449	                 EMP-HOURLY-RATE * WS-BONUS-FACTOR
450	             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-PAY =
451	                 WS-OVERTIME-HOURS * WS-OVERTIME-RATE
452	             COMPUTE WS-GROSS-SALARY =
453	                 WS-REGULAR-PAY + WS-OVERTIME-PAY
454	         WHEN OTHER
455	             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-HOURS =
456	                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED
457	             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-PAY =
458	                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED * EMP-HOURLY-RATE
459	             MOVE WS-REGULAR-PAY TO WS-GROSS-SALARY
460	     END-EVALUATE.
461	
462	 2150-CALCULATE-DEDUCTIONS.
463	     COMPUTE WS-HEALTH-DEDUCTION ROUNDED =
464	         WS-GROSS-SALARY * WS-HEALTH-RATE
465	     COMPUTE WS-RETIRE-DEDUCTION ROUNDED =
466	         WS-GROSS-SALARY * WS-RETIRE-RATE
467	     COMPUTE WS-UNEMP-DEDUCTION  ROUNDED =
468	         WS-GROSS-SALARY * WS-UNEMP-RATE
469	     COMPUTE WS-TOTAL-DEDUCTION =
470	         WS-HEALTH-DEDUCTION + WS-RETIRE-DEDUCTION
471	         + WS-UNEMP-DEDUCTION
472	     COMPUTE WS-NET-SALARY =
473	         WS-GROSS-SALARY - WS-TOTAL-DEDUCTION.
474	
475	 2200-WRITE-PAYSLIP.
476	     MOVE EMP-ID           TO WSP-ID
477	     MOVE EMP-NAME         TO WSP-NAME
478	     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY     TO WSP-CATEGORY
479	     MOVE EMP-HOURS-WORKED TO WSP-HOURS
480	     MOVE EMP-HOURLY-RATE  TO WSP-RATE
481	     MOVE WS-REGULAR-PAY   TO WSP-REGULAR
482	     MOVE WS-OVERTIME-PAY  TO WSP-OVERTIME
483	     MOVE WS-GROSS-SALARY     TO WSP-GROSS
484	     MOVE WS-HEALTH-DEDUCTION TO WSP-HEALTH
485	     MOVE WS-RETIRE-DEDUCTION TO WSP-RETIREMENT
486	     MOVE WS-UNEMP-DEDUCTION  TO WSP-UNEMPLOYMENT
487	     MOVE WS-TOTAL-DEDUCTION  TO WSP-TOTAL-DED
488	     MOVE WS-NET-SALARY       TO WSP-NET
489	     WRITE PAYSLIP-RECORD FROM WS-PAYSLIP-LINE
490	     IF NOT PAY-FILE-OK
491	         DISPLAY "ERROR: Write error - Status: " WS-PAY-STATUS
492	     END-IF.
493	
494	 2300-DISPLAY-EMPLOYEE.
495	     MOVE EMP-ID           TO WSD-ID
496	     MOVE EMP-NAME         TO WSD-NAME
497	     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY     TO WSD-CATEGORY
498	     MOVE EMP-HOURS-WORKED TO WSD-HOURS
499	     MOVE EMP-HOURLY-RATE  TO WSD-RATE
500	     MOVE WS-GROSS-SALARY  TO WSD-GROSS
501	     MOVE WS-NET-SALARY    TO WSD-NET
502	     DISPLAY WS-DISPLAY-LINE.
503	
504	 2400-ACCUMULATE-CATEGORY.
505	     EVALUATE TRUE
506	         WHEN CATEGORY-A
507	             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-A-COUNT
508	             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-A-PAYROLL
509	             ADD WS-NET-SALARY   TO WS-CAT-A-NET
510	         WHEN CATEGORY-B
511	             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-B-COUNT
512	             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-B-PAYROLL
513	             ADD WS-NET-SALARY   TO WS-CAT-B-NET
514	         WHEN CATEGORY-C
515	             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-C-COUNT
516	             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-C-PAYROLL
517	             ADD WS-NET-SALARY   TO WS-CAT-C-NET
518	         WHEN OTHER
519	             CONTINUE
520	     END-EVALUATE.
521	
522	 3000-FINALIZATION.
523	     PERFORM 3100-BUILD-CATEGORY-TABLE
524	     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
525	     MOVE WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES TO WS-TOT-EMP-DISP
526	     DISPLAY WS-TOTAL-DISP
527	     MOVE WS-FULLTIME-COUNT  TO WS-TOT-FT-DISP
528	     DISPLAY WS-FT-COUNT-DISP
529	     MOVE WS-PARTTIME-COUNT  TO WS-TOT-PT-DISP
530	     DISPLAY WS-PT-COUNT-DISP
531	     MOVE WS-TOTAL-REJECTED  TO WS-TOT-REJ-DISP
532	     DISPLAY WS-REJECTED-DISP
533	     MOVE WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL   TO WS-TOT-PAY-DISP
534	     DISPLAY WS-PAYROLL-DISP
535	     MOVE WS-TOTAL-NET       TO WS-TOT-NET-DISP
536	     DISPLAY WS-NET-PAYROLL-DISP
537	     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
538	     DISPLAY "           BREAKDOWN BY JOB CATEGORY               "
539	     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
540	     PERFORM 3200-DISPLAY-CATEGORY-SUMMARY
541	         VARYING WS-CAT-IDX FROM 1 BY 1
542	         UNTIL WS-CAT-IDX > 3
543	     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
544	     PERFORM 3300-WRITE-REPORT-FILE
545	     CLOSE PAYSLIP-FILE
546	     CLOSE REJECT-FILE
547	     CLOSE REPORT-FILE
548	     DISPLAY "JOB COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY".
549	
550	 3100-BUILD-CATEGORY-TABLE.
551	     MOVE "A"              TO WS-CAT-LABEL   (1)
552	     MOVE WS-CAT-A-COUNT  TO WS-CAT-COUNT   (1)
553	     MOVE WS-CAT-A-PAYROLL TO WS-CAT-TOTAL  (1)
554	     MOVE WS-CAT-A-NET    TO WS-CAT-NET-TOT (1)
555	     MOVE "B"              TO WS-CAT-LABEL   (2)
556	     MOVE WS-CAT-B-COUNT  TO WS-CAT-COUNT   (2)
557	     MOVE WS-CAT-B-PAYROLL TO WS-CAT-TOTAL  (2)
558	     MOVE WS-CAT-B-NET    TO WS-CAT-NET-TOT (2)
559	     MOVE "C"              TO WS-CAT-LABEL   (3)
560	     MOVE WS-CAT-C-COUNT  TO WS-CAT-COUNT   (3)
561	     MOVE WS-CAT-C-PAYROLL TO WS-CAT-TOTAL  (3)
562	     MOVE WS-CAT-C-NET    TO WS-CAT-NET-TOT (3).
563	
564	 3200-DISPLAY-CATEGORY-SUMMARY.
565	     MOVE WS-CAT-LABEL (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WCR-LABEL
566	     MOVE WS-CAT-COUNT (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WCR-COUNT
567	     MOVE WS-CAT-TOTAL (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WCR-TOTAL
568	     DISPLAY WS-CAT-REPORT-LINE.
569	
570	 3300-WRITE-REPORT-FILE.
571	     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-HEADER
572	     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-SEPARATOR
573	     PERFORM 3350-WRITE-REPORT-CAT-LINE
574	         VARYING WS-CAT-IDX FROM 1 BY 1
575	         UNTIL WS-CAT-IDX > 3
576	     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-SEPARATOR
577	     PERFORM 3400-WRITE-GRAND-TOTAL
578	     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-SEPARATOR.
579	
580	 3350-WRITE-REPORT-CAT-LINE.
581	     MOVE WS-CAT-LABEL   (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WRC-LABEL
582	     MOVE WS-CAT-COUNT   (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WRC-COUNT
583	     MOVE WS-CAT-TOTAL   (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WRC-GROSS
584	     MOVE WS-CAT-NET-TOT (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WRC-NET
585	     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-CAT-LINE
586	     IF NOT RPT-FILE-OK
587	         DISPLAY "ERROR: Report write error - Status: "
588	             WS-RPT-STATUS
589	     END-IF.
590	
591	 3400-WRITE-GRAND-TOTAL.
592	     MOVE WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES TO WRG-COUNT
593	     MOVE WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL   TO WRG-GROSS
594	     MOVE WS-TOTAL-NET       TO WRG-NET
595	     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-GRAND-LINE
596	     IF NOT RPT-FILE-OK
597	         DISPLAY "ERROR: Report write error - Status: "
598	             WS-RPT-STATUS
599	     END-IF.
600

file.content:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
 PROGRAM-ID. PAYROLL-SYSTEM.
 AUTHOR. PAYROLL-DEPT.

 ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
 CONFIGURATION SECTION.
 SOURCE-COMPUTER. LINUX.
 OBJECT-COMPUTER. LINUX.
 INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
 FILE-CONTROL.
     SELECT FULLTIME-FILE
         ASSIGN TO "employees_fulltime.dat"
         ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL
         ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL
         FILE STATUS IS WS-FT-STATUS.
     SELECT PARTTIME-FILE
         ASSIGN TO "employees_parttime.dat"
         ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL
         ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL
         FILE STATUS IS WS-PT-STATUS.
     SELECT PAYSLIP-FILE
         ASSIGN TO "payslips_output.dat"
         ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL
         ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL
         FILE STATUS IS WS-PAY-STATUS.
     SELECT REJECT-FILE
         ASSIGN TO "rejects_output.dat"
         ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL
         ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL
         FILE STATUS IS WS-REJ-STATUS.
     SELECT REPORT-FILE
         ASSIGN TO "report_output.dat"
         ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL
         ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL
         FILE STATUS IS WS-RPT-STATUS.

 DATA DIVISION.
 FILE SECTION.

 FD FULLTIME-FILE
     RECORD CONTAINS 37 CHARACTERS.
 01 FT-RECORD               PIC X(37).

 FD PARTTIME-FILE
     RECORD CONTAINS 37 CHARACTERS.
 01 PT-RECORD               PIC X(37).

 FD PAYSLIP-FILE
     RECORD CONTAINS 123 CHARACTERS.
 01 PAYSLIP-RECORD          PIC X(123).

 FD REJECT-FILE
     RECORD CONTAINS 45 CHARACTERS.
 01 REJECT-RECORD           PIC X(45).

 FD REPORT-FILE
     RECORD CONTAINS 70 CHARACTERS.
 01 REPORT-RECORD            PIC X(70).

 WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.

 01 WS-FILE-STATUS.
     05 WS-FT-STATUS        PIC X(2).
         88 FT-FILE-OK      VALUE "00".
         88 FT-EOF          VALUE "10".
     05 WS-PT-STATUS        PIC X(2).
         88 PT-FILE-OK      VALUE "00".
         88 PT-EOF          VALUE "10".
     05 WS-PAY-STATUS       PIC X(2).
         88 PAY-FILE-OK     VALUE "00".
     05 WS-REJ-STATUS       PIC X(2).
         88 REJ-FILE-OK     VALUE "00".
     05 WS-RPT-STATUS       PIC X(2).
         88 RPT-FILE-OK     VALUE "00".

 01 WS-FLAGS.
     05 WS-END-OF-FILE      PIC X(1) VALUE "N".
         88 END-OF-FILE     VALUE "Y".
         88 NOT-END-OF-FILE VALUE "N".

 01 WS-CURRENT-FILE         PIC X(2) VALUE "FT".
     88 PROCESSING-FULLTIME VALUE "FT".
     88 PROCESSING-PARTTIME VALUE "PT".

 01 EMPLOYEE-RECORD.
     05 EMP-ID              PIC 9(6).
     05 EMP-ID-X            REDEFINES EMP-ID PIC X(6).
     05 EMP-NAME            PIC X(20).
     05 EMP-CATEGORY        PIC X(1).
     05 EMP-HOURS-WORKED    PIC 9(3)V9(1).
     05 EMP-HOURLY-RATE     PIC 9(4)V9(2).

 01 WS-VALIDATION.
     05 WS-RECORD-VALID     PIC X(1) VALUE "Y".
         88 RECORD-VALID    VALUE "Y".
         88 RECORD-INVALID  VALUE "N".
     05 WS-VALIDATION-CODE  PIC X(7) VALUE SPACES.

 01 WS-COMPUTATION.
     05 WS-REGULAR-HOURS    PIC 9(3)V9(1) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-OVERTIME-HOURS   PIC 9(3)V9(1) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-REGULAR-PAY      PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-OVERTIME-PAY     PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-GROSS-SALARY     PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-OVERTIME-RATE    PIC 9(4)V9(4) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-BONUS-FACTOR     PIC 9(1)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-HEALTH-DEDUCTION PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-RETIRE-DEDUCTION PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-UNEMP-DEDUCTION  PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-TOTAL-DEDUCTION  PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-NET-SALARY       PIC 9(7)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.

 01 WS-LIMITS.
     05 WS-STANDARD-HOURS   PIC 9(3)V9(1) VALUE 35.0.

 01 WS-CONTRIB-RATES.
     05 WS-HEALTH-RATE      PIC V9(4) VALUE .0730.
     05 WS-RETIRE-RATE      PIC V9(4) VALUE .0690.
     05 WS-UNEMP-RATE       PIC V9(4) VALUE .0240.

 01 WS-TOTALS.
     05 WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES  PIC 9(6) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-TOTAL-REJECTED   PIC 9(6) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL    PIC 9(9)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-TOTAL-NET        PIC 9(9)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-FULLTIME-COUNT   PIC 9(6) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-PARTTIME-COUNT   PIC 9(6) VALUE ZEROES.

 01 WS-CAT-SUBTOTALS.
     05 WS-CAT-A-COUNT      PIC 9(6) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-CAT-A-PAYROLL    PIC 9(9)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-CAT-A-NET        PIC 9(9)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-CAT-B-COUNT      PIC 9(6) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-CAT-B-PAYROLL    PIC 9(9)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-CAT-B-NET        PIC 9(9)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-CAT-C-COUNT      PIC 9(6) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-CAT-C-PAYROLL    PIC 9(9)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.
     05 WS-CAT-C-NET        PIC 9(9)V9(2) VALUE ZEROES.

 01 WS-CATEGORY-TABLE.
     05 WS-CAT-ENTRY OCCURS 3 TIMES INDEXED BY WS-CAT-IDX.
         10 WS-CAT-LABEL    PIC X(1).
         10 WS-CAT-COUNT    PIC 9(6).
         10 WS-CAT-TOTAL    PIC 9(9)V9(2).
         10 WS-CAT-NET-TOT  PIC 9(9)V9(2).

 01 WS-CAT-REPORT-LINE.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(9)  VALUE "CATEGORY ".
     05 WCR-LABEL           PIC X(1).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(13) VALUE " - EMPLOYEES:".
     05 WCR-COUNT           PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(9)  VALUE " PAYROLL:".
     05 WCR-TOTAL           PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.99.

 01 WS-LOOP-INDEX           PIC 9(2) VALUE 1.

 01 WS-CATEGORY-FLAGS.
     05 WS-CAT              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACES.
         88 CATEGORY-A      VALUE "A".
         88 CATEGORY-B      VALUE "B".
         88 CATEGORY-C      VALUE "C".

 01 WS-PAYSLIP-LINE.
     05 WSP-ID              PIC 9(6).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-NAME            PIC X(20).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-CATEGORY        PIC X(1).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-HOURS           PIC ZZZ.9.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-RATE            PIC ZZZZ.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-REGULAR         PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-OVERTIME        PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-GROSS           PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-HEALTH          PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-RETIREMENT      PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-UNEMPLOYMENT    PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-TOTAL-DED       PIC ZZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSP-NET             PIC ZZZZZ9.99.

 01 WS-REJECT-LINE.
     05 WRJ-EMP-DATA        PIC X(37).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WRJ-ERROR-CODE      PIC X(7).

 01 WS-RPT-HEADER.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(10) VALUE "CATEGORY  ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(12) VALUE "EMPLOYEES   ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(20) VALUE "GROSS PAYROLL       ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(20) VALUE "NET PAYROLL         ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(8)  VALUE SPACES.

 01 WS-RPT-SEPARATOR.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(70)
         VALUE ALL "-".

 01 WS-RPT-CAT-LINE.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(5)  VALUE "  ".
     05 WRC-LABEL           PIC X(1).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(4)  VALUE SPACES.
     05 WRC-COUNT           PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(2)  VALUE SPACES.
     05 WRC-GROSS           PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(2)  VALUE SPACES.
     05 WRC-NET             PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.99.

 01 WS-RPT-GRAND-LINE.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(10) VALUE "TOTAL     ".
     05 WRG-COUNT           PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(2)  VALUE SPACES.
     05 WRG-GROSS           PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(2)  VALUE SPACES.
     05 WRG-NET             PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.99.

 01 WS-TOTAL-DISP.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(30)
         VALUE "EMPLOYEES VALID (PROCESSED) : ".
     05 WS-TOT-EMP-DISP     PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.

 01 WS-REJECTED-DISP.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(30)
         VALUE "EMPLOYEES REJECTED          : ".
     05 WS-TOT-REJ-DISP     PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.

 01 WS-FT-COUNT-DISP.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(30)
         VALUE "  FROM FULL-TIME FILE       : ".
     05 WS-TOT-FT-DISP      PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.

 01 WS-PT-COUNT-DISP.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(30)
         VALUE "  FROM PART-TIME FILE       : ".
     05 WS-TOT-PT-DISP      PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.

 01 WS-PAYROLL-DISP.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(30)
         VALUE "TOTAL GROSS PAYROLL         : ".
     05 WS-TOT-PAY-DISP     PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.99.

 01 WS-NET-PAYROLL-DISP.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(30)
         VALUE "TOTAL NET PAYROLL           : ".
     05 WS-TOT-NET-DISP     PIC ZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.99.

 01 WS-SEPARATOR.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(60)
         VALUE "------------------------------------------------------------".

 01 WS-HEADER-LINE.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(60)
         VALUE "           PAYROLL PROCESSING REPORT                       ".

 01 WS-COL-HEADER.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(6)  VALUE "EMP-ID".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(2)  VALUE SPACES.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(20) VALUE "NAME                ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(4)  VALUE "CAT ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(8)  VALUE "HOURS   ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(8)  VALUE "RATE    ".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(12) VALUE "GROSS SALARY".
     05 FILLER              PIC X(2)  VALUE SPACES.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(10) VALUE "NET SALARY".

 01 WS-DISPLAY-LINE.
     05 WSD-ID              PIC 9(6).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSD-NAME            PIC X(20).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSD-CATEGORY        PIC X(1).
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSD-HOURS           PIC ZZ9.9.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSD-RATE            PIC ZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSD-GROSS           PIC ZZZZ9.99.
     05 FILLER              PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
     05 WSD-NET             PIC ZZZZ9.99.

 PROCEDURE DIVISION.

 0000-MAIN-CONTROL.
     PERFORM 1000-INITIALIZATION
     MOVE "FT" TO WS-CURRENT-FILE
     DISPLAY "--- PROCESSING FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES ---"
     PERFORM 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE
     PERFORM 2000-PROCESS-EMPLOYEES
         UNTIL END-OF-FILE
     CLOSE FULLTIME-FILE
     MOVE "N" TO WS-END-OF-FILE
     MOVE "PT" TO WS-CURRENT-FILE
     DISPLAY "--- PROCESSING PART-TIME EMPLOYEES ---"
     PERFORM 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE
     PERFORM 2000-PROCESS-EMPLOYEES
         UNTIL END-OF-FILE
     CLOSE PARTTIME-FILE
     PERFORM 3000-FINALIZATION
     STOP RUN.

 1000-INITIALIZATION.
     OPEN INPUT FULLTIME-FILE
     IF NOT FT-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Cannot open employees_fulltime.dat"
             " - Status: " WS-FT-STATUS
         STOP RUN
     END-IF
     OPEN INPUT PARTTIME-FILE
     IF NOT PT-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Cannot open employees_parttime.dat"
             " - Status: " WS-PT-STATUS
         STOP RUN
     END-IF
     OPEN OUTPUT PAYSLIP-FILE
     IF NOT PAY-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Cannot open payslips_output.dat"
             " - Status: " WS-PAY-STATUS
         STOP RUN
     END-IF
     OPEN OUTPUT REJECT-FILE
     IF NOT REJ-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Cannot open rejects_output.dat"
             " - Status: " WS-REJ-STATUS
         STOP RUN
     END-IF
     OPEN OUTPUT REPORT-FILE
     IF NOT RPT-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Cannot open report_output.dat"
             " - Status: " WS-RPT-STATUS
         STOP RUN
     END-IF
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     DISPLAY WS-HEADER-LINE
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     DISPLAY WS-COL-HEADER
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR.

 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.
     IF PROCESSING-FULLTIME
         READ FULLTIME-FILE INTO EMPLOYEE-RECORD
         EVALUATE TRUE
             WHEN FT-EOF
                 MOVE "Y" TO WS-END-OF-FILE
             WHEN NOT FT-FILE-OK
                 DISPLAY "ERROR: Read error FT - Status: "
                     WS-FT-STATUS
                 MOVE "Y" TO WS-END-OF-FILE
         END-EVALUATE
     ELSE
         READ PARTTIME-FILE INTO EMPLOYEE-RECORD
         EVALUATE TRUE
             WHEN PT-EOF
                 MOVE "Y" TO WS-END-OF-FILE
             WHEN NOT PT-FILE-OK
                 DISPLAY "ERROR: Read error PT - Status: "
                     WS-PT-STATUS
                 MOVE "Y" TO WS-END-OF-FILE
         END-EVALUATE
     END-IF.

 2000-PROCESS-EMPLOYEES.
     PERFORM 1900-VALIDATE-RECORD
     IF RECORD-VALID
         PERFORM 2100-CALCULATE-SALARY
         PERFORM 2150-CALCULATE-DEDUCTIONS
         PERFORM 2200-WRITE-PAYSLIP
         PERFORM 2300-DISPLAY-EMPLOYEE
         ADD 1 TO WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES
         IF PROCESSING-FULLTIME
             ADD 1 TO WS-FULLTIME-COUNT
         ELSE
             ADD 1 TO WS-PARTTIME-COUNT
         END-IF
         ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL
         ADD WS-NET-SALARY   TO WS-TOTAL-NET
         PERFORM 2400-ACCUMULATE-CATEGORY
     ELSE
         PERFORM 1950-WRITE-REJECT
     END-IF
     PERFORM 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.

 1900-VALIDATE-RECORD.
     MOVE "Y" TO WS-RECORD-VALID
     MOVE SPACES TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY TO WS-CAT
     EVALUATE TRUE
         WHEN EMP-ID-X = SPACES OR EMP-ID-X = "000000"
             MOVE "N"       TO WS-RECORD-VALID
             MOVE "ERR-001" TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
         WHEN EMP-HOURS-WORKED <= ZEROES
           OR EMP-HOURS-WORKED > 80
             MOVE "N"       TO WS-RECORD-VALID
             MOVE "ERR-002" TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
         WHEN EMP-HOURLY-RATE <= ZEROES
           OR EMP-HOURLY-RATE > 999.99
             MOVE "N"       TO WS-RECORD-VALID
             MOVE "ERR-003" TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
         WHEN NOT (CATEGORY-A OR CATEGORY-B OR CATEGORY-C)
             MOVE "N"       TO WS-RECORD-VALID
             MOVE "ERR-004" TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
     END-EVALUATE.

 1950-WRITE-REJECT.
     MOVE EMPLOYEE-RECORD   TO WRJ-EMP-DATA
     MOVE WS-VALIDATION-CODE TO WRJ-ERROR-CODE
     WRITE REJECT-RECORD FROM WS-REJECT-LINE
     IF NOT REJ-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Reject write error - Status: "
             WS-REJ-STATUS
     END-IF
     ADD 1 TO WS-TOTAL-REJECTED
     DISPLAY "REJECTED [" WS-VALIDATION-CODE "]: "
         EMP-ID SPACE EMP-NAME.

 2100-CALCULATE-SALARY.
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY TO WS-CAT
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-REGULAR-PAY
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-OVERTIME-PAY
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-GROSS-SALARY
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-OVERTIME-HOURS
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-REGULAR-HOURS
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
     EVALUATE TRUE
         WHEN EMP-HOURS-WORKED > WS-STANDARD-HOURS
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-HOURS =
                 WS-STANDARD-HOURS
             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-HOURS =
                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED - WS-STANDARD-HOURS
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-PAY =
                 WS-REGULAR-HOURS * EMP-HOURLY-RATE
             EVALUATE TRUE
                 WHEN CATEGORY-A
                     MOVE 1.20 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
                 WHEN CATEGORY-B
                     MOVE 1.10 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
                 WHEN CATEGORY-C
                     MOVE 1.00 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
                 WHEN OTHER
                     MOVE 1.00 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
             END-EVALUATE
             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-RATE =
                 EMP-HOURLY-RATE * WS-BONUS-FACTOR
             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-PAY =
                 WS-OVERTIME-HOURS * WS-OVERTIME-RATE
             COMPUTE WS-GROSS-SALARY =
                 WS-REGULAR-PAY + WS-OVERTIME-PAY
         WHEN OTHER
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-HOURS =
                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-PAY =
                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED * EMP-HOURLY-RATE
             MOVE WS-REGULAR-PAY TO WS-GROSS-SALARY
     END-EVALUATE.

 2150-CALCULATE-DEDUCTIONS.
     COMPUTE WS-HEALTH-DEDUCTION ROUNDED =
         WS-GROSS-SALARY * WS-HEALTH-RATE
     COMPUTE WS-RETIRE-DEDUCTION ROUNDED =
         WS-GROSS-SALARY * WS-RETIRE-RATE
     COMPUTE WS-UNEMP-DEDUCTION  ROUNDED =
         WS-GROSS-SALARY * WS-UNEMP-RATE
     COMPUTE WS-TOTAL-DEDUCTION =
         WS-HEALTH-DEDUCTION + WS-RETIRE-DEDUCTION
         + WS-UNEMP-DEDUCTION
     COMPUTE WS-NET-SALARY =
         WS-GROSS-SALARY - WS-TOTAL-DEDUCTION.

 2200-WRITE-PAYSLIP.
     MOVE EMP-ID           TO WSP-ID
     MOVE EMP-NAME         TO WSP-NAME
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY     TO WSP-CATEGORY
     MOVE EMP-HOURS-WORKED TO WSP-HOURS
     MOVE EMP-HOURLY-RATE  TO WSP-RATE
     MOVE WS-REGULAR-PAY   TO WSP-REGULAR
     MOVE WS-OVERTIME-PAY  TO WSP-OVERTIME
     MOVE WS-GROSS-SALARY     TO WSP-GROSS
     MOVE WS-HEALTH-DEDUCTION TO WSP-HEALTH
     MOVE WS-RETIRE-DEDUCTION TO WSP-RETIREMENT
     MOVE WS-UNEMP-DEDUCTION  TO WSP-UNEMPLOYMENT
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-DEDUCTION  TO WSP-TOTAL-DED
     MOVE WS-NET-SALARY       TO WSP-NET
     WRITE PAYSLIP-RECORD FROM WS-PAYSLIP-LINE
     IF NOT PAY-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Write error - Status: " WS-PAY-STATUS
     END-IF.

 2300-DISPLAY-EMPLOYEE.
     MOVE EMP-ID           TO WSD-ID
     MOVE EMP-NAME         TO WSD-NAME
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY     TO WSD-CATEGORY
     MOVE EMP-HOURS-WORKED TO WSD-HOURS
     MOVE EMP-HOURLY-RATE  TO WSD-RATE
     MOVE WS-GROSS-SALARY  TO WSD-GROSS
     MOVE WS-NET-SALARY    TO WSD-NET
     DISPLAY WS-DISPLAY-LINE.

 2400-ACCUMULATE-CATEGORY.
     EVALUATE TRUE
         WHEN CATEGORY-A
             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-A-COUNT
             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-A-PAYROLL
             ADD WS-NET-SALARY   TO WS-CAT-A-NET
         WHEN CATEGORY-B
             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-B-COUNT
             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-B-PAYROLL
             ADD WS-NET-SALARY   TO WS-CAT-B-NET
         WHEN CATEGORY-C
             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-C-COUNT
             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-C-PAYROLL
             ADD WS-NET-SALARY   TO WS-CAT-C-NET
         WHEN OTHER
             CONTINUE
     END-EVALUATE.

 3000-FINALIZATION.
     PERFORM 3100-BUILD-CATEGORY-TABLE
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES TO WS-TOT-EMP-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-TOTAL-DISP
     MOVE WS-FULLTIME-COUNT  TO WS-TOT-FT-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-FT-COUNT-DISP
     MOVE WS-PARTTIME-COUNT  TO WS-TOT-PT-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-PT-COUNT-DISP
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-REJECTED  TO WS-TOT-REJ-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-REJECTED-DISP
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL   TO WS-TOT-PAY-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-PAYROLL-DISP
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-NET       TO WS-TOT-NET-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-NET-PAYROLL-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     DISPLAY "           BREAKDOWN BY JOB CATEGORY               "
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     PERFORM 3200-DISPLAY-CATEGORY-SUMMARY
         VARYING WS-CAT-IDX FROM 1 BY 1
         UNTIL WS-CAT-IDX > 3
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     PERFORM 3300-WRITE-REPORT-FILE
     CLOSE PAYSLIP-FILE
     CLOSE REJECT-FILE
     CLOSE REPORT-FILE
     DISPLAY "JOB COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY".

 3100-BUILD-CATEGORY-TABLE.
     MOVE "A"              TO WS-CAT-LABEL   (1)
     MOVE WS-CAT-A-COUNT  TO WS-CAT-COUNT   (1)
     MOVE WS-CAT-A-PAYROLL TO WS-CAT-TOTAL  (1)
     MOVE WS-CAT-A-NET    TO WS-CAT-NET-TOT (1)
     MOVE "B"              TO WS-CAT-LABEL   (2)
     MOVE WS-CAT-B-COUNT  TO WS-CAT-COUNT   (2)
     MOVE WS-CAT-B-PAYROLL TO WS-CAT-TOTAL  (2)
     MOVE WS-CAT-B-NET    TO WS-CAT-NET-TOT (2)
     MOVE "C"              TO WS-CAT-LABEL   (3)
     MOVE WS-CAT-C-COUNT  TO WS-CAT-COUNT   (3)
     MOVE WS-CAT-C-PAYROLL TO WS-CAT-TOTAL  (3)
     MOVE WS-CAT-C-NET    TO WS-CAT-NET-TOT (3).

 3200-DISPLAY-CATEGORY-SUMMARY.
     MOVE WS-CAT-LABEL (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WCR-LABEL
     MOVE WS-CAT-COUNT (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WCR-COUNT
     MOVE WS-CAT-TOTAL (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WCR-TOTAL
     DISPLAY WS-CAT-REPORT-LINE.

 3300-WRITE-REPORT-FILE.
     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-HEADER
     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-SEPARATOR
     PERFORM 3350-WRITE-REPORT-CAT-LINE
         VARYING WS-CAT-IDX FROM 1 BY 1
         UNTIL WS-CAT-IDX > 3
     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-SEPARATOR
     PERFORM 3400-WRITE-GRAND-TOTAL
     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-SEPARATOR.

 3350-WRITE-REPORT-CAT-LINE.
     MOVE WS-CAT-LABEL   (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WRC-LABEL
     MOVE WS-CAT-COUNT   (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WRC-COUNT
     MOVE WS-CAT-TOTAL   (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WRC-GROSS
     MOVE WS-CAT-NET-TOT (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WRC-NET
     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-CAT-LINE
     IF NOT RPT-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Report write error - Status: "
             WS-RPT-STATUS
     END-IF.

 3400-WRITE-GRAND-TOTAL.
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES TO WRG-COUNT
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL   TO WRG-GROSS
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-NET       TO WRG-NET
     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-GRAND-LINE
     IF NOT RPT-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Report write error - Status: "
             WS-RPT-STATUS
     END-IF.

file.content:
PROCEDURE DIVISION.

 0000-MAIN-CONTROL.
     PERFORM 1000-INITIALIZATION
     MOVE "FT" TO WS-CURRENT-FILE
     DISPLAY "--- PROCESSING FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES ---"
     PERFORM 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE
     PERFORM 2000-PROCESS-EMPLOYEES
         UNTIL END-OF-FILE
     CLOSE FULLTIME-FILE
     MOVE "N" TO WS-END-OF-FILE
     MOVE "PT" TO WS-CURRENT-FILE
     DISPLAY "--- PROCESSING PART-TIME EMPLOYEES ---"
     PERFORM 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE
     PERFORM 2000-PROCESS-EMPLOYEES
         UNTIL END-OF-FILE
     CLOSE PARTTIME-FILE
     PERFORM 3000-FINALIZATION
     STOP RUN.

 1000-INITIALIZATION.
     OPEN INPUT FULLTIME-FILE
     IF NOT FT-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Cannot open employees_fulltime.dat"
             " - Status: " WS-FT-STATUS
         STOP RUN
     END-IF
     OPEN INPUT PARTTIME-FILE
     IF NOT PT-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Cannot open employees_parttime.dat"
             " - Status: " WS-PT-STATUS
         STOP RUN
     END-IF
     OPEN OUTPUT PAYSLIP-FILE
     IF NOT PAY-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Cannot open payslips_output.dat"
             " - Status: " WS-PAY-STATUS
         STOP RUN
     END-IF
     OPEN OUTPUT REJECT-FILE
     IF NOT REJ-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Cannot open rejects_output.dat"
             " - Status: " WS-REJ-STATUS
         STOP RUN
     END-IF
     OPEN OUTPUT REPORT-FILE
     IF NOT RPT-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Cannot open report_output.dat"
             " - Status: " WS-RPT-STATUS
         STOP RUN
     END-IF
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     DISPLAY WS-HEADER-LINE
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     DISPLAY WS-COL-HEADER
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR.

 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.
     IF PROCESSING-FULLTIME
         READ FULLTIME-FILE INTO EMPLOYEE-RECORD
         EVALUATE TRUE
             WHEN FT-EOF
                 MOVE "Y" TO WS-END-OF-FILE
             WHEN NOT FT-FILE-OK
                 DISPLAY "ERROR: Read error FT - Status: "
                     WS-FT-STATUS
                 MOVE "Y" TO WS-END-OF-FILE
         END-EVALUATE
     ELSE
         READ PARTTIME-FILE INTO EMPLOYEE-RECORD
         EVALUATE TRUE
             WHEN PT-EOF
                 MOVE "Y" TO WS-END-OF-FILE
             WHEN NOT PT-FILE-OK
                 DISPLAY "ERROR: Read error PT - Status: "
                     WS-PT-STATUS
                 MOVE "Y" TO WS-END-OF-FILE
         END-EVALUATE
     END-IF.

 2000-PROCESS-EMPLOYEES.
     PERFORM 1900-VALIDATE-RECORD
     IF RECORD-VALID
         PERFORM 2100-CALCULATE-SALARY
         PERFORM 2150-CALCULATE-DEDUCTIONS
         PERFORM 2200-WRITE-PAYSLIP
         PERFORM 2300-DISPLAY-EMPLOYEE
         ADD 1 TO WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES
         IF PROCESSING-FULLTIME
             ADD 1 TO WS-FULLTIME-COUNT
         ELSE
             ADD 1 TO WS-PARTTIME-COUNT
         END-IF
         ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL
         ADD WS-NET-SALARY   TO WS-TOTAL-NET
         PERFORM 2400-ACCUMULATE-CATEGORY
     ELSE
         PERFORM 1950-WRITE-REJECT
     END-IF
     PERFORM 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.

 1900-VALIDATE-RECORD.
     MOVE "Y" TO WS-RECORD-VALID
     MOVE SPACES TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY TO WS-CAT
     EVALUATE TRUE
         WHEN EMP-ID-X = SPACES OR EMP-ID-X = "000000"
             MOVE "N"       TO WS-RECORD-VALID
             MOVE "ERR-001" TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
         WHEN EMP-HOURS-WORKED <= ZEROES
           OR EMP-HOURS-WORKED > 80
             MOVE "N"       TO WS-RECORD-VALID
             MOVE "ERR-002" TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
         WHEN EMP-HOURLY-RATE <= ZEROES
           OR EMP-HOURLY-RATE > 999.99
             MOVE "N"       TO WS-RECORD-VALID
             MOVE "ERR-003" TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
         WHEN NOT (CATEGORY-A OR CATEGORY-B OR CATEGORY-C)
             MOVE "N"       TO WS-RECORD-VALID
             MOVE "ERR-004" TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
     END-EVALUATE.

 1950-WRITE-REJECT.
     MOVE EMPLOYEE-RECORD   TO WRJ-EMP-DATA
     MOVE WS-VALIDATION-CODE TO WRJ-ERROR-CODE
     WRITE REJECT-RECORD FROM WS-REJECT-LINE
     IF NOT REJ-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Reject write error - Status: "
             WS-REJ-STATUS
     END-IF
     ADD 1 TO WS-TOTAL-REJECTED
     DISPLAY "REJECTED [" WS-VALIDATION-CODE "]: "
         EMP-ID SPACE EMP-NAME.

 2100-CALCULATE-SALARY.
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY TO WS-CAT
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-REGULAR-PAY
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-OVERTIME-PAY
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-GROSS-SALARY
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-OVERTIME-HOURS
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-REGULAR-HOURS
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
     EVALUATE TRUE
         WHEN EMP-HOURS-WORKED > WS-STANDARD-HOURS
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-HOURS =
                 WS-STANDARD-HOURS
             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-HOURS =
                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED - WS-STANDARD-HOURS
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-PAY =
                 WS-REGULAR-HOURS * EMP-HOURLY-RATE
             EVALUATE TRUE
                 WHEN CATEGORY-A
                     MOVE 1.20 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
                 WHEN CATEGORY-B
                     MOVE 1.10 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
                 WHEN CATEGORY-C
                     MOVE 1.00 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
                 WHEN OTHER
                     MOVE 1.00 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
             END-EVALUATE
             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-RATE =
                 EMP-HOURLY-RATE * WS-BONUS-FACTOR
             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-PAY =
                 WS-OVERTIME-HOURS * WS-OVERTIME-RATE
             COMPUTE WS-GROSS-SALARY =
                 WS-REGULAR-PAY + WS-OVERTIME-PAY
         WHEN OTHER
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-HOURS =
                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-PAY =
                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED * EMP-HOURLY-RATE
             MOVE WS-REGULAR-PAY TO WS-GROSS-SALARY
     END-EVALUATE.

 2150-CALCULATE-DEDUCTIONS.
     COMPUTE WS-HEALTH-DEDUCTION ROUNDED =
         WS-GROSS-SALARY * WS-HEALTH-RATE
     COMPUTE WS-RETIRE-DEDUCTION ROUNDED =
         WS-GROSS-SALARY * WS-RETIRE-RATE
     COMPUTE WS-UNEMP-DEDUCTION  ROUNDED =
         WS-GROSS-SALARY * WS-UNEMP-RATE
     COMPUTE WS-TOTAL-DEDUCTION =
         WS-HEALTH-DEDUCTION + WS-RETIRE-DEDUCTION
         + WS-UNEMP-DEDUCTION
     COMPUTE WS-NET-SALARY =
         WS-GROSS-SALARY - WS-TOTAL-DEDUCTION.

 2200-WRITE-PAYSLIP.
     MOVE EMP-ID           TO WSP-ID
     MOVE EMP-NAME         TO WSP-NAME
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY     TO WSP-CATEGORY
     MOVE EMP-HOURS-WORKED TO WSP-HOURS
     MOVE EMP-HOURLY-RATE  TO WSP-RATE
     MOVE WS-REGULAR-PAY   TO WSP-REGULAR
     MOVE WS-OVERTIME-PAY  TO WSP-OVERTIME
     MOVE WS-GROSS-SALARY     TO WSP-GROSS
     MOVE WS-HEALTH-DEDUCTION TO WSP-HEALTH
     MOVE WS-RETIRE-DEDUCTION TO WSP-RETIREMENT
     MOVE WS-UNEMP-DEDUCTION  TO WSP-UNEMPLOYMENT
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-DEDUCTION  TO WSP-TOTAL-DED
     MOVE WS-NET-SALARY       TO WSP-NET
     WRITE PAYSLIP-RECORD FROM WS-PAYSLIP-LINE
     IF NOT PAY-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Write error - Status: " WS-PAY-STATUS
     END-IF.

 2300-DISPLAY-EMPLOYEE.
     MOVE EMP-ID           TO WSD-ID
     MOVE EMP-NAME         TO WSD-NAME
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY     TO WSD-CATEGORY
     MOVE EMP-HOURS-WORKED TO WSD-HOURS
     MOVE EMP-HOURLY-RATE  TO WSD-RATE
     MOVE WS-GROSS-SALARY  TO WSD-GROSS
     MOVE WS-NET-SALARY    TO WSD-NET
     DISPLAY WS-DISPLAY-LINE.

 2400-ACCUMULATE-CATEGORY.
     EVALUATE TRUE
         WHEN CATEGORY-A
             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-A-COUNT
             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-A-PAYROLL
             ADD WS-NET-SALARY   TO WS-CAT-A-NET
         WHEN CATEGORY-B
             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-B-COUNT
             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-B-PAYROLL
             ADD WS-NET-SALARY   TO WS-CAT-B-NET
         WHEN CATEGORY-C
             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-C-COUNT
             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-C-PAYROLL
             ADD WS-NET-SALARY   TO WS-CAT-C-NET
         WHEN OTHER
             CONTINUE
     END-EVALUATE.

 3000-FINALIZATION.
     PERFORM 3100-BUILD-CATEGORY-TABLE
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES TO WS-TOT-EMP-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-TOTAL-DISP
     MOVE WS-FULLTIME-COUNT  TO WS-TOT-FT-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-FT-COUNT-DISP
     MOVE WS-PARTTIME-COUNT  TO WS-TOT-PT-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-PT-COUNT-DISP
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-REJECTED  TO WS-TOT-REJ-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-REJECTED-DISP
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL   TO WS-TOT-PAY-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-PAYROLL-DISP
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-NET       TO WS-TOT-NET-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-NET-PAYROLL-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     DISPLAY "           BREAKDOWN BY JOB CATEGORY               "
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     PERFORM 3200-DISPLAY-CATEGORY-SUMMARY
         VARYING WS-CAT-IDX FROM 1 BY 1
         UNTIL WS-CAT-IDX > 3
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     PERFORM 3300-WRITE-REPORT-FILE
     CLOSE PAYSLIP-FILE
     CLOSE REJECT-FILE
     CLOSE REPORT-FILE
     DISPLAY "JOB COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY".

 3100-BUILD-CATEGORY-TABLE.
     MOVE "A"              TO WS-CAT-LABEL   (1)
     MOVE WS-CAT-A-COUNT  TO WS-CAT-COUNT   (1)
     MOVE WS-CAT-A-PAYROLL TO WS-CAT-TOTAL  (1)
     MOVE WS-CAT-A-NET    TO WS-CAT-NET-TOT (1)
     MOVE "B"              TO WS-CAT-LABEL   (2)
     MOVE WS-CAT-B-COUNT  TO WS-CAT-COUNT   (2)
     MOVE WS-CAT-B-PAYROLL TO WS-CAT-TOTAL  (2)
     MOVE WS-CAT-B-NET    TO WS-CAT-NET-TOT (2)
     MOVE "C"              TO WS-CAT-LABEL   (3)
     MOVE WS-CAT-C-COUNT  TO WS-CAT-COUNT   (3)
     MOVE WS-CAT-C-PAYROLL TO WS-CAT-TOTAL  (3)
     MOVE WS-CAT-C-NET    TO WS-CAT-NET-TOT (3).

 3200-DISPLAY-CATEGORY-SUMMARY.
     MOVE WS-CAT-LABEL (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WCR-LABEL
     MOVE WS-CAT-COUNT (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WCR-COUNT
     MOVE WS-CAT-TOTAL (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WCR-TOTAL
     DISPLAY WS-CAT-REPORT-LINE.

 3300-WRITE-REPORT-FILE.
     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-HEADER
     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-SEPARATOR
     PERFORM 3350-WRITE-REPORT-CAT-LINE
         VARYING WS-CAT-IDX FROM 1 BY 1
         UNTIL WS-CAT-IDX > 3
     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-SEPARATOR
     PERFORM 3400-WRITE-GRAND-TOTAL
     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-SEPARATOR.

 3350-WRITE-REPORT-CAT-LINE.
     MOVE WS-CAT-LABEL   (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WRC-LABEL
     MOVE WS-CAT-COUNT   (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WRC-COUNT
     MOVE WS-CAT-TOTAL   (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WRC-GROSS
     MOVE WS-CAT-NET-TOT (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WRC-NET
     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-CAT-LINE
     IF NOT RPT-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Report write error - Status: "
             WS-RPT-STATUS
     END-IF.

 3400-WRITE-GRAND-TOTAL.
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES TO WRG-COUNT
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL   TO WRG-GROSS
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-NET       TO WRG-NET
     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-GRAND-LINE
     IF NOT RPT-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Report write error - Status: "
             WS-RPT-STATUS
     END-IF.

         ADD WS-NET-SALARY   TO WS-TOTAL-NET
         PERFORM 2400-ACCUMULATE-CATEGORY
     ELSE
         PERFORM 1950-WRITE-REJECT
     END-IF
     PERFORM 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.

 1900-VALIDATE-RECORD.
     MOVE "Y" TO WS-RECORD-VALID
     MOVE SPACES TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY TO WS-CAT
     EVALUATE TRUE
         WHEN EMP-ID-X = SPACES OR EMP-ID-X = "000000"
             MOVE "N"       TO WS-RECORD-VALID
             MOVE "ERR-001" TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
         WHEN EMP-HOURS-WORKED <= ZEROES
           OR EMP-HOURS-WORKED > 80
             MOVE "N"       TO WS-RECORD-VALID
             MOVE "ERR-002" TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
         WHEN EMP-HOURLY-RATE <= ZEROES
           OR EMP-HOURLY-RATE > 999.99
             MOVE "N"       TO WS-RECORD-VALID
             MOVE "ERR-003" TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
         WHEN NOT (CATEGORY-A OR CATEGORY-B OR CATEGORY-C)
             MOVE "N"       TO WS-RECORD-VALID
             MOVE "ERR-004" TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
     END-EVALUATE.

 1950-WRITE-REJECT.
     MOVE EMPLOYEE-RECORD   TO WRJ-EMP-DATA
     MOVE WS-VALIDATION-CODE TO WRJ-ERROR-CODE
     WRITE REJECT-RECORD FROM WS-REJECT-LINE
     IF NOT REJ-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Reject write error - Status: "
             WS-REJ-STATUS
     END-IF
     ADD 1 TO WS-TOTAL-REJECTED
     DISPLAY "REJECTED [" WS-VALIDATION-CODE "]: "
         EMP-ID SPACE EMP-NAME.

 2100-CALCULATE-SALARY.
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY TO WS-CAT
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-REGULAR-PAY
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-OVERTIME-PAY
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-GROSS-SALARY
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-OVERTIME-HOURS
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-REGULAR-HOURS
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
     EVALUATE TRUE
         WHEN EMP-HOURS-WORKED > WS-STANDARD-HOURS
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-HOURS =
                 WS-STANDARD-HOURS
             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-HOURS =
                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED - WS-STANDARD-HOURS
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-PAY =
                 WS-REGULAR-HOURS * EMP-HOURLY-RATE
             EVALUATE TRUE
                 WHEN CATEGORY-A
                     MOVE 1.20 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
                 WHEN CATEGORY-B
                     MOVE 1.10 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
                 WHEN CATEGORY-C
                     MOVE 1.00 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
                 WHEN OTHER
                     MOVE 1.00 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
             END-EVALUATE
             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-RATE =
                 EMP-HOURLY-RATE * WS-BONUS-FACTOR
             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-PAY =
                 WS-OVERTIME-HOURS * WS-OVERTIME-RATE
             COMPUTE WS-GROSS-SALARY =
                 WS-REGULAR-PAY + WS-OVERTIME-PAY
         WHEN OTHER
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-HOURS =
                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-PAY =
                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED * EMP-HOURLY-RATE
             MOVE WS-REGULAR-PAY TO WS-GROSS-SALARY
     END-EVALUATE.

 2150-CALCULATE-DEDUCTIONS.
     COMPUTE WS-HEALTH-DEDUCTION ROUNDED =
         WS-GROSS-SALARY * WS-HEALTH-RATE
     COMPUTE WS-RETIRE-DEDUCTION ROUNDED =
         WS-GROSS-SALARY * WS-RETIRE-RATE
     COMPUTE WS-UNEMP-DEDUCTION  ROUNDED =
         WS-GROSS-SALARY * WS-UNEMP-RATE
     COMPUTE WS-TOTAL-DEDUCTION =
         WS-HEALTH-DEDUCTION + WS-RETIRE-DEDUCTION
         + WS-UNEMP-DEDUCTION
     COMPUTE WS-NET-SALARY =
         WS-GROSS-SALARY - WS-TOTAL-DEDUCTION.

 2200-WRITE-PAYSLIP.
     MOVE EMP-ID           TO WSP-ID
     MOVE EMP-NAME         TO WSP-NAME
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY     TO WSP-CATEGORY
     MOVE EMP-HOURS-WORKED TO WSP-HOURS
     MOVE EMP-HOURLY-RATE  TO WSP-RATE
     MOVE WS-REGULAR-PAY   TO WSP-REGULAR
     MOVE WS-OVERTIME-PAY  TO WSP-OVERTIME
     MOVE WS-GROSS-SALARY     TO WSP-GROSS
     MOVE WS-HEALTH-DEDUCTION TO WSP-HEALTH
     MOVE WS-RETIRE-DEDUCTION TO WSP-RETIREMENT
     MOVE WS-UNEMP-DEDUCTION  TO WSP-UNEMPLOYMENT
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-DEDUCTION  TO WSP-TOTAL-DED
     MOVE WS-NET-SALARY       TO WSP-NET
     WRITE PAYSLIP-RECORD FROM WS-PAYSLIP-LINE
     IF NOT PAY-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Write error - Status: " WS-PAY-STATUS
     END-IF.

 2300-DISPLAY-EMPLOYEE.
     MOVE EMP-ID           TO WSD-ID
     MOVE EMP-NAME         TO WSD-NAME
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY     TO WSD-CATEGORY
     MOVE EMP-HOURS-WORKED TO WSD-HOURS
     MOVE EMP-HOURLY-RATE  TO WSD-RATE
     MOVE WS-GROSS-SALARY  TO WSD-GROSS
     MOVE WS-NET-SALARY    TO WSD-NET
     DISPLAY WS-DISPLAY-LINE.

 2400-ACCUMULATE-CATEGORY.
     EVALUATE TRUE
         WHEN CATEGORY-A
             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-A-COUNT
             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-A-PAYROLL
             ADD WS-NET-SALARY   TO WS-CAT-A-NET
         WHEN CATEGORY-B
             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-B-COUNT
             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-B-PAYROLL
             ADD WS-NET-SALARY   TO WS-CAT-B-NET
         WHEN CATEGORY-C
             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-C-COUNT
             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-C-PAYROLL
             ADD WS-NET-SALARY   TO WS-CAT-C-NET
         WHEN OTHER
             CONTINUE
     END-EVALUATE.

 3000-FINALIZATION.
     PERFORM 3100-BUILD-CATEGORY-TABLE
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES TO WS-TOT-EMP-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-TOTAL-DISP
     MOVE WS-FULLTIME-COUNT  TO WS-TOT-FT-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-FT-COUNT-DISP
     MOVE WS-PARTTIME-COUNT  TO WS-TOT-PT-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-PT-COUNT-DISP
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-REJECTED  TO WS-TOT-REJ-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-REJECTED-DISP
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL   TO WS-TOT-PAY-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-PAYROLL-DISP
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-NET       TO WS-TOT-NET-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-NET-PAYROLL-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     DISPLAY "           BREAKDOWN BY JOB CATEGORY               "
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     PERFORM 3200-DISPLAY-CATEGORY-SUMMARY
         VARYING WS-CAT-IDX FROM 1 BY 1
         UNTIL WS-CAT-IDX > 3
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     PERFORM 3300-WRITE-REPORT-FILE
     CLOSE PAYSLIP-FILE
     CLOSE REJECT-FILE
     CLOSE REPORT-FILE
     DISPLAY "JOB COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY".

 3100-BUILD-CATEGORY-TABLE.
     MOVE "A"              TO WS-CAT-LABEL   (1)
     MOVE WS-CAT-A-COUNT  TO WS-CAT-COUNT   (1)
     MOVE WS-CAT-A-PAYROLL TO WS-CAT-TOTAL  (1)
     MOVE WS-CAT-A-NET    TO WS-CAT-NET-TOT (1)
     MOVE "B"              TO WS-CAT-LABEL   (2)
     MOVE WS-CAT-B-COUNT  TO WS-CAT-COUNT   (2)
     MOVE WS-CAT-B-PAYROLL TO WS-CAT-TOTAL  (2)
     MOVE WS-CAT-B-NET    TO WS-CAT-NET-TOT (2)
     MOVE "C"              TO WS-CAT-LABEL   (3)
     MOVE WS-CAT-C-COUNT  TO WS-CAT-COUNT   (3)
     MOVE WS-CAT-C-PAYROLL TO WS-CAT-TOTAL  (3)
     MOVE WS-CAT-C-NET    TO WS-CAT-NET-TOT (3).

 3200-DISPLAY-CATEGORY-SUMMARY.
     MOVE WS-CAT-LABEL (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WCR-LABEL
     MOVE WS-CAT-COUNT (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WCR-COUNT
     MOVE WS-CAT-TOTAL (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WCR-TOTAL
     DISPLAY WS-CAT-REPORT-LINE.

 3300-WRITE-REPORT-FILE.
     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-HEADER
     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-SEPARATOR
     PERFORM 3350-WRITE-REPORT-CAT-LINE
         VARYING WS-CAT-IDX FROM 1 BY 1
         UNTIL WS-CAT-IDX > 3
     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-SEPARATOR
     PERFORM 3400-WRITE-GRAND-TOTAL
     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-SEPARATOR.

 3350-WRITE-REPORT-CAT-LINE.
     MOVE WS-CAT-LABEL   (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WRC-LABEL
     MOVE WS-CAT-COUNT   (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WRC-COUNT
     MOVE WS-CAT-TOTAL   (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WRC-GROSS
     MOVE WS-CAT-NET-TOT (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WRC-NET
     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-CAT-LINE
     IF NOT RPT-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Report write error - Status: "
             WS-RPT-STATUS
     END-IF.

 3400-WRITE-GRAND-TOTAL.
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES TO WRG-COUNT
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL   TO WRG-GROSS
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-NET       TO WRG-NET
     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-GRAND-LINE
     IF NOT RPT-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Report write error - Status: "
             WS-RPT-STATUS
     END-IF.

     IF NOT REJ-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Cannot open rejects_output.dat"
             " - Status: " WS-REJ-STATUS
         STOP RUN
     END-IF
     OPEN OUTPUT REPORT-FILE
     IF NOT RPT-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Cannot open report_output.dat"
             " - Status: " WS-RPT-STATUS
         STOP RUN
     END-IF
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     DISPLAY WS-HEADER-LINE
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     DISPLAY WS-COL-HEADER
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR.

 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.
     IF PROCESSING-FULLTIME
         READ FULLTIME-FILE INTO EMPLOYEE-RECORD
         EVALUATE TRUE
             WHEN FT-EOF
                 MOVE "Y" TO WS-END-OF-FILE
             WHEN NOT FT-FILE-OK
                 DISPLAY "ERROR: Read error FT - Status: "
                     WS-FT-STATUS
                 MOVE "Y" TO WS-END-OF-FILE
         END-EVALUATE
     ELSE
         READ PARTTIME-FILE INTO EMPLOYEE-RECORD
         EVALUATE TRUE
             WHEN PT-EOF
                 MOVE "Y" TO WS-END-OF-FILE
             WHEN NOT PT-FILE-OK
                 DISPLAY "ERROR: Read error PT - Status: "
                     WS-PT-STATUS
                 MOVE "Y" TO WS-END-OF-FILE
         END-EVALUATE
     END-IF.

 2000-PROCESS-EMPLOYEES.
     PERFORM 1900-VALIDATE-RECORD
     IF RECORD-VALID
         PERFORM 2100-CALCULATE-SALARY
         PERFORM 2150-CALCULATE-DEDUCTIONS
         PERFORM 2200-WRITE-PAYSLIP
         PERFORM 2300-DISPLAY-EMPLOYEE
         ADD 1 TO WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES
         IF PROCESSING-FULLTIME
             ADD 1 TO WS-FULLTIME-COUNT
         ELSE
             ADD 1 TO WS-PARTTIME-COUNT
         END-IF
         ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL
         ADD WS-NET-SALARY   TO WS-TOTAL-NET
         PERFORM 2400-ACCUMULATE-CATEGORY
     ELSE
         PERFORM 1950-WRITE-REJECT
     END-IF
     PERFORM 1100-READ-EMPLOYEE.

 1900-VALIDATE-RECORD.
     MOVE "Y" TO WS-RECORD-VALID
     MOVE SPACES TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY TO WS-CAT
     EVALUATE TRUE
         WHEN EMP-ID-X = SPACES OR EMP-ID-X = "000000"
             MOVE "N"       TO WS-RECORD-VALID
             MOVE "ERR-001" TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
         WHEN EMP-HOURS-WORKED <= ZEROES
           OR EMP-HOURS-WORKED > 80
             MOVE "N"       TO WS-RECORD-VALID
             MOVE "ERR-002" TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
         WHEN EMP-HOURLY-RATE <= ZEROES
           OR EMP-HOURLY-RATE > 999.99
             MOVE "N"       TO WS-RECORD-VALID
             MOVE "ERR-003" TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
         WHEN NOT (CATEGORY-A OR CATEGORY-B OR CATEGORY-C)
             MOVE "N"       TO WS-RECORD-VALID
             MOVE "ERR-004" TO WS-VALIDATION-CODE
     END-EVALUATE.

 1950-WRITE-REJECT.
     MOVE EMPLOYEE-RECORD   TO WRJ-EMP-DATA
     MOVE WS-VALIDATION-CODE TO WRJ-ERROR-CODE
     WRITE REJECT-RECORD FROM WS-REJECT-LINE
     IF NOT REJ-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Reject write error - Status: "
             WS-REJ-STATUS
     END-IF
     ADD 1 TO WS-TOTAL-REJECTED
     DISPLAY "REJECTED [" WS-VALIDATION-CODE "]: "
         EMP-ID SPACE EMP-NAME.

 2100-CALCULATE-SALARY.
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY TO WS-CAT
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-REGULAR-PAY
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-OVERTIME-PAY
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-GROSS-SALARY
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-OVERTIME-HOURS
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-REGULAR-HOURS
     MOVE ZEROES TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
     EVALUATE TRUE
         WHEN EMP-HOURS-WORKED > WS-STANDARD-HOURS
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-HOURS =
                 WS-STANDARD-HOURS
             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-HOURS =
                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED - WS-STANDARD-HOURS
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-PAY =
                 WS-REGULAR-HOURS * EMP-HOURLY-RATE
             EVALUATE TRUE
                 WHEN CATEGORY-A
                     MOVE 1.20 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
                 WHEN CATEGORY-B
                     MOVE 1.10 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
                 WHEN CATEGORY-C
                     MOVE 1.00 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
                 WHEN OTHER
                     MOVE 1.00 TO WS-BONUS-FACTOR
             END-EVALUATE
             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-RATE =
                 EMP-HOURLY-RATE * WS-BONUS-FACTOR
             COMPUTE WS-OVERTIME-PAY =
                 WS-OVERTIME-HOURS * WS-OVERTIME-RATE
             COMPUTE WS-GROSS-SALARY =
                 WS-REGULAR-PAY + WS-OVERTIME-PAY
         WHEN OTHER
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-HOURS =
                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED
             COMPUTE WS-REGULAR-PAY =
                 EMP-HOURS-WORKED * EMP-HOURLY-RATE
             MOVE WS-REGULAR-PAY TO WS-GROSS-SALARY
     END-EVALUATE.

 2150-CALCULATE-DEDUCTIONS.
     COMPUTE WS-HEALTH-DEDUCTION ROUNDED =
         WS-GROSS-SALARY * WS-HEALTH-RATE
     COMPUTE WS-RETIRE-DEDUCTION ROUNDED =
         WS-GROSS-SALARY * WS-RETIRE-RATE
     COMPUTE WS-UNEMP-DEDUCTION  ROUNDED =
         WS-GROSS-SALARY * WS-UNEMP-RATE
     COMPUTE WS-TOTAL-DEDUCTION =
         WS-HEALTH-DEDUCTION + WS-RETIRE-DEDUCTION
         + WS-UNEMP-DEDUCTION
     COMPUTE WS-NET-SALARY =
         WS-GROSS-SALARY - WS-TOTAL-DEDUCTION.

 2200-WRITE-PAYSLIP.
     MOVE EMP-ID           TO WSP-ID
     MOVE EMP-NAME         TO WSP-NAME
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY     TO WSP-CATEGORY
     MOVE EMP-HOURS-WORKED TO WSP-HOURS
     MOVE EMP-HOURLY-RATE  TO WSP-RATE
     MOVE WS-REGULAR-PAY   TO WSP-REGULAR
     MOVE WS-OVERTIME-PAY  TO WSP-OVERTIME
     MOVE WS-GROSS-SALARY     TO WSP-GROSS
     MOVE WS-HEALTH-DEDUCTION TO WSP-HEALTH
     MOVE WS-RETIRE-DEDUCTION TO WSP-RETIREMENT
     MOVE WS-UNEMP-DEDUCTION  TO WSP-UNEMPLOYMENT
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-DEDUCTION  TO WSP-TOTAL-DED
     MOVE WS-NET-SALARY       TO WSP-NET
     WRITE PAYSLIP-RECORD FROM WS-PAYSLIP-LINE
     IF NOT PAY-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Write error - Status: " WS-PAY-STATUS
     END-IF.

 2300-DISPLAY-EMPLOYEE.
     MOVE EMP-ID           TO WSD-ID
     MOVE EMP-NAME         TO WSD-NAME
     MOVE EMP-CATEGORY     TO WSD-CATEGORY
     MOVE EMP-HOURS-WORKED TO WSD-HOURS
     MOVE EMP-HOURLY-RATE  TO WSD-RATE
     MOVE WS-GROSS-SALARY  TO WSD-GROSS
     MOVE WS-NET-SALARY    TO WSD-NET
     DISPLAY WS-DISPLAY-LINE.

 2400-ACCUMULATE-CATEGORY.
     EVALUATE TRUE
         WHEN CATEGORY-A
             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-A-COUNT
             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-A-PAYROLL
             ADD WS-NET-SALARY   TO WS-CAT-A-NET
         WHEN CATEGORY-B
             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-B-COUNT
             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-B-PAYROLL
             ADD WS-NET-SALARY   TO WS-CAT-B-NET
         WHEN CATEGORY-C
             ADD 1 TO WS-CAT-C-COUNT
             ADD WS-GROSS-SALARY TO WS-CAT-C-PAYROLL
             ADD WS-NET-SALARY   TO WS-CAT-C-NET
         WHEN OTHER
             CONTINUE
     END-EVALUATE.

 3000-FINALIZATION.
     PERFORM 3100-BUILD-CATEGORY-TABLE
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES TO WS-TOT-EMP-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-TOTAL-DISP
     MOVE WS-FULLTIME-COUNT  TO WS-TOT-FT-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-FT-COUNT-DISP
     MOVE WS-PARTTIME-COUNT  TO WS-TOT-PT-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-PT-COUNT-DISP
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-REJECTED  TO WS-TOT-REJ-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-REJECTED-DISP
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL   TO WS-TOT-PAY-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-PAYROLL-DISP
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-NET       TO WS-TOT-NET-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-NET-PAYROLL-DISP
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     DISPLAY "           BREAKDOWN BY JOB CATEGORY               "
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     PERFORM 3200-DISPLAY-CATEGORY-SUMMARY
         VARYING WS-CAT-IDX FROM 1 BY 1
         UNTIL WS-CAT-IDX > 3
     DISPLAY WS-SEPARATOR
     PERFORM 3300-WRITE-REPORT-FILE
     CLOSE PAYSLIP-FILE
     CLOSE REJECT-FILE
     CLOSE REPORT-FILE
     DISPLAY "JOB COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY".

 3100-BUILD-CATEGORY-TABLE.
     MOVE "A"              TO WS-CAT-LABEL   (1)
     MOVE WS-CAT-A-COUNT  TO WS-CAT-COUNT   (1)
     MOVE WS-CAT-A-PAYROLL TO WS-CAT-TOTAL  (1)
     MOVE WS-CAT-A-NET    TO WS-CAT-NET-TOT (1)
     MOVE "B"              TO WS-CAT-LABEL   (2)
     MOVE WS-CAT-B-COUNT  TO WS-CAT-COUNT   (2)
     MOVE WS-CAT-B-PAYROLL TO WS-CAT-TOTAL  (2)
     MOVE WS-CAT-B-NET    TO WS-CAT-NET-TOT (2)
     MOVE "C"              TO WS-CAT-LABEL   (3)
     MOVE WS-CAT-C-COUNT  TO WS-CAT-COUNT   (3)
     MOVE WS-CAT-C-PAYROLL TO WS-CAT-TOTAL  (3)
     MOVE WS-CAT-C-NET    TO WS-CAT-NET-TOT (3).

 3200-DISPLAY-CATEGORY-SUMMARY.
     MOVE WS-CAT-LABEL (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WCR-LABEL
     MOVE WS-CAT-COUNT (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WCR-COUNT
     MOVE WS-CAT-TOTAL (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WCR-TOTAL
     DISPLAY WS-CAT-REPORT-LINE.

 3300-WRITE-REPORT-FILE.
     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-HEADER
     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-SEPARATOR
     PERFORM 3350-WRITE-REPORT-CAT-LINE
         VARYING WS-CAT-IDX FROM 1 BY 1
         UNTIL WS-CAT-IDX > 3
     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-SEPARATOR
     PERFORM 3400-WRITE-GRAND-TOTAL
     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-SEPARATOR.

 3350-WRITE-REPORT-CAT-LINE.
     MOVE WS-CAT-LABEL   (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WRC-LABEL
     MOVE WS-CAT-COUNT   (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WRC-COUNT
     MOVE WS-CAT-TOTAL   (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WRC-GROSS
     MOVE WS-CAT-NET-TOT (WS-CAT-IDX) TO WRC-NET
     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-CAT-LINE
     IF NOT RPT-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Report write error - Status: "
             WS-RPT-STATUS
     END-IF.

 3400-WRITE-GRAND-TOTAL.
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-EMPLOYEES TO WRG-COUNT
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-PAYROLL   TO WRG-GROSS
     MOVE WS-TOTAL-NET       TO WRG-NET
     WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-RPT-GRAND-LINE
     IF NOT RPT-FILE-OK
         DISPLAY "ERROR: Report write error - Status: "
             WS-RPT-STATUS
     END-IF.
